summary.summary: No-operation attribute setter for spans; records no trace data but satisfies tracer interface.
summary.docSummary: Sets a span attribute in the no-operation tracer. This no-op implementation allows attribute recording to be disabled transparently without code path changes.

summary.summary: No-operation error recorder for spans; performs no tracing but satisfies interface contract.
summary.docSummary: Records an error in the no-operation tracer. This implementation performs no action, enabling error tracing to be disabled transparently.

summary.summary: No-operation event recorder for spans; performs no tracing but maintains interface compatibility.
summary.docSummary: Adds an event to a span in the no-operation tracer. This no-op implementation allows event recording to be disabled without modifying instrumented code.

summary.summary: Starts a new span in the no-operation tracer, returning the input context with a NopSpan to bypass actual tracing.
summary.docSummary: Starts a new span in the no-operation tracer. Returns the input context paired with a NopSpan, implementing the null object pattern to disable tracing transparently.

summary.summary: Validates AgentConfig provider, mode, output format, and prompt with mode-specific and mutual exclusivity rules.
summary.docSummary: Validates AgentConfig before execution, checking provider, mode, output format, mutual exclusivity of prompt fields, and mode-specific constraints. Essential for ensuring valid configuration before agent startup.

summary.summary: Returns configured timeout or default as time.Duration.
summary.docSummary: Returns the execution timeout duration. Uses configured timeout or DefaultAgentTimeout if not set. Call this to retrieve the actual timeout value for deadline management.

summary.summary: Checks if agent is in conversation mode.
summary.docSummary: Determines if the agent operates in conversation mode. Distinguish between single-turn and multi-turn execution models.

summary.summary: Returns the agent's prompt string.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the agent's prompt string. The prompt field is used to construct the initial message for the agent.

summary.summary: Creates AgentResult instance with provider, empty response map, and current timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Factory constructor for AgentResult. Initializes execution tracking with provider name, empty response map, and start timestamp. Use when creating a new agent execution result.

summary.summary: Computes elapsed time between agent start and completion.
summary.docSummary: Computes agent execution duration. Returns the elapsed time between start and completion, useful for performance monitoring and metrics.

summary.summary: Checks if result succeeded (non-nil with no error).
summary.docSummary: Checks execution success status. Returns true only if the result exists and contains no error. Use to determine if agent completed without issues.

summary.summary: Checks if response map contains data.
summary.docSummary: Checks if the response contains data. Returns true if the response map is non-empty, indicating the agent produced structured output.

summary.summary: Factory that creates an audit event recording workflow execution start, capturing execution context, masked inputs, and user identity.
summary.docSummary: Creates a workflow start audit event from execution context and user information. Records the initial state when workflow execution begins, including masked inputs for security.

summary.summary: Factory that constructs a workflow completion audit event, deriving status from exit code and calculating execution duration.
summary.docSummary: Generates a workflow completion audit event capturing final execution state. Derives status from exit code, includes execution duration, and logs any errors that occurred.

summary.summary: Custom JSON marshaler that conditionally serializes audit event fields and formats timestamps to RFC3339 precision.
summary.docSummary: Implements custom JSON serialization for audit events with selective field inclusion. Handles optional fields conditionally and ensures consistent RFC3339 timestamp formatting.

summary.summary: Utility that writes a JSON field with key-value pair to a buffer, handling comma separation between fields.
summary.docSummary: Helper function for building JSON output manually. Writes key-value pairs to a buffer with proper comma separation, used internally by MarshalJSON.

summary.summary: Checks if the transition collection contains a default (unconditional) transition by detecting an empty When field.
summary.docSummary: Determines whether the transitions include a default case that matches regardless of condition evaluation. Default transitions serve as fallback paths when no conditional transitions match.

summary.summary: Validates that a Transition specifies a required non-empty destination state in the Goto field, returning an error if missing.
summary.docSummary: Ensures transition validity by requiring a target state. Every transition must have a non-empty Goto field to define the workflow's next state.

summary.summary: Generates a human-readable string representation of a Transition, formatted as 'goto {destination}' for defaults or 'when {condition} goto {destination}' for conditionals.
summary.docSummary: Returns a formatted string describing the transition's condition and target state. Default transitions omit the condition clause, while conditional transitions display their When expression.

summary.summary: Extracts all destination states from the transition collection into a slice by collecting each Goto value.
summary.docSummary: Returns the complete list of possible target states reachable from this transition set. Useful for validating state references and analyzing workflow reachability.

summary.summary: Locates the index of the default (unconditional) transition by searching for an empty When field, returning -1 if none exists.
summary.docSummary: Identifies the position of the default transition in the ordered list. Returns -1 if no default exists, allowing callers to determine fallback behavior or enforce transition ordering.

summary.summary: Evaluates transition conditions in order using a provided evaluator function and returns the first matching transition's target state, with default transitions checked first.
summary.docSummary: Executes condition evaluation in sequence and returns the destination of the first matching transition. Default transitions take precedence. Condition evaluation errors are wrapped and propagated.

summary.summary: Creates a default OutputLimits configuration with unlimited size, truncation disabled, and system temp directory usage.
summary.docSummary: Provides default output limit configuration for workflows: unlimited output size, truncation disabled, and system-managed temporary storage. Initialize output handling when no specific size constraints are required.

summary.summary: Creates a default LoopMemoryConfig with unlimited iteration retention.
summary.docSummary: Provides default loop memory configuration for workflows with unlimited retained iterations. Initialize memory settings when no iteration retention constraints are needed.

summary.summary: Converts ExecutionStatus to its string representation.
summary.docSummary: Simple type conversion method for rendering status values as strings.

summary.summary: Creates and initializes ExecutionContext with workflow metadata, empty input/state maps, and startup timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Factory function for creating workflow execution contexts with default initialization including timing and empty state collections.

summary.summary: Stores workflow input values with thread-safe synchronization and updates modification timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Sets workflow input parameters with automatic timestamp tracking and mutex-protected concurrent access.

summary.summary: Retrieves stored input values with read-lock protection and returns existence status.
summary.docSummary: Fetches workflow input values with concurrent-safe read locking.

summary.summary: Stores step execution state with thread-safe locking and updates modification timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Manages per-step execution state with mutex synchronization and automatic timestamp updates.

summary.summary: Removes step state entry if exists and updates modification timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Deletes step execution state with conditional cleanup and timestamp maintenance.

summary.summary: Retrieves step state with read-lock protection and returns existence status.
summary.docSummary: Fetches per-step execution state with concurrent-safe read locking.

summary.summary: Returns a defensive copy of all step states to prevent concurrent modification.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves all step execution states as an immutable snapshot with thread-safe copying.

summary.summary: Appends workflow name to call stack with thread-safe locking and updates modification timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Tracks nested workflow invocations by pushing names onto the execution call stack.

summary.summary: Removes the last workflow name from call stack with thread-safe locking and updates modification timestamp.
summary.docSummary: Pops workflow names from execution call stack when exiting nested invocations.

summary.summary: Checks if workflow name exists in call stack with read-lock protection for cycle detection.
summary.docSummary: Detects recursive workflow invocation patterns for cycle prevention in nested calls.

summary.summary: Returns current call stack depth with read-lock protection for tracking nesting level.
summary.docSummary: Provides call stack depth for tracking invocation nesting level and enforcing recursion limits.

summary.summary: Creates a Turn struct with the given role and content string.
summary.docSummary: Constructor for creating a new conversation turn with specified role and content.

summary.summary: Validates Turn fields: role must be non-empty and valid (system, user, or assistant), content must be non-empty, and tokens must be non-negative.
summary.docSummary: Validates Turn struct ensuring role is one of system/user/assistant, content is present, and tokens are non-negative.

summary.summary: Creates ConversationState with optional system prompt added as first turn if provided.
summary.docSummary: Initializes a conversation state with an optional system prompt. If provided, the system prompt is added as the first turn.

summary.summary: Appends turn to conversation state and updates total turn and token counters.
summary.docSummary: Adds a new turn to the conversation state. Updates total turn count and token count. Returns error if turn is nil.

summary.summary: Returns the cumulative token count across all turns in the conversation.
summary.docSummary: Returns the cumulative token count across all turns in the conversation.

summary.summary: Returns pointer to the most recent turn in conversation, or nil if no turns exist.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the most recent turn in the conversation. Returns nil if no turns exist.

summary.summary: Searches backwards through turns to find and return the content of the most recent assistant response.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the content of the most recent assistant response. Returns empty string if no assistant turn exists.

summary.summary: Returns true if conversation has been stopped (StoppedBy field is non-empty), false otherwise.
summary.docSummary: Determines if the conversation has reached a stop condition. Returns true if a stop reason is present.

summary.summary: Creates ConversationResult with given provider and initializes state, output, response, and timing fields.
summary.docSummary: Initializes a conversation result object for tracking the outcome of a provider interaction including tokens, timing, and state management.

summary.summary: Calculates elapsed time between StartedAt and CompletedAt, or returns zero duration if either timestamp is zero.
summary.docSummary: Calculates the duration of the conversation execution. Returns zero duration if timing data is incomplete.

summary.summary: Returns true if Error field is nil, indicating the operation completed without error.
summary.docSummary: Indicates whether the conversation result completed without error.

summary.summary: Returns true if Response map contains any entries, indicating a structured JSON response was received.
summary.docSummary: Determines whether a structured JSON response was returned from the provider interaction.

summary.summary: Returns total number of turns from conversation state, or 0 if state is nil.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the total number of turns in the conversation. Returns zero if conversation state is uninitialized.

summary.summary: Converts VisitState enum value to its string representation for logging and display purposes.
summary.docSummary: Returns the string representation of a VisitState value.

summary.summary: Locates the starting index of a cycle within a traversal path by searching for the target state.
summary.docSummary: Finds the index where a cycle begins by locating the target state within the path. Returns -1 if not found.

summary.summary: Constructs a cycle path from a given start index through the end of the path, closing the loop with the target state.
summary.docSummary: Builds a cycle representation from a slice starting at startIndex and ending with target, forming a complete cycle.

summary.summary: Validates workflow graph structure by checking initial state existence, transition validity, reachability, terminal states, and cycle detection.
summary.docSummary: Performs comprehensive validation of a workflow graph including state existence, transition references, reachability analysis, and cycle detection. Returns a ValidationResult containing all errors and warnings.

summary.summary: Performs depth-first search to identify all states reachable from the initial state in the workflow graph.
summary.docSummary: Analyzes workflow connectivity via DFS traversal starting from the initial state. Returns a map indicating which states are reachable.

summary.summary: Detects all cycles in the workflow graph using depth-first search with color-based state tracking.
summary.docSummary: Identifies cycles in the workflow graph using DFS color-marking algorithm. Returns a slice of formatted cycle paths as strings.

summary.summary: Formats a cycle path as a human-readable string with arrow separators between state names.
summary.docSummary: Formats a cycle path into a readable string representation using arrow notation (e.g., 'A -> B -> C').

summary.summary: Determines the next step to execute by finding the first unconditional transition or using the default on_success path.
summary.docSummary: Identifies the next step for workflow execution, prioritizing unconditional transitions (where When is empty) or falling back to on_success.

summary.summary: Constructs the execution order of workflow steps by following the default transition path from initial state until a terminal state is reached.
summary.docSummary: Builds an ordered sequence of steps for workflow execution by following default transitions from the initial state until reaching a terminal step.

summary.summary: Extracts all possible next states from a given step, including success/failure paths and parallel branches.
summary.docSummary: Collects all outbound transitions from a step including on_success, on_failure, and parallel branches. Returns nil for terminal steps.

summary.summary: Returns the string representation of a LoopType
summary.docSummary: Implements the Stringer interface for LoopType, providing human-readable representations of loop type values.

summary.summary: Validates loop configuration by checking type, required fields, and iteration constraints
summary.docSummary: Validates LoopConfig before execution, checking type requirements, required field presence, and iteration limits. Must succeed before loop execution begins.

summary.summary: Checks whether max iterations are specified as a dynamic expression
summary.docSummary: Returns true if max iterations use dynamic expressions. Determines whether iteration bounds require runtime evaluation vs compile-time validation.

summary.summary: Calculates elapsed time for an iteration from start to completion
summary.docSummary: Returns the wall-clock duration of a loop iteration as the difference between CompletedAt and StartedAt.

summary.summary: Indicates whether an iteration completed without errors
summary.docSummary: Returns true if iteration succeeded (nil error), false otherwise. Evaluates iteration-level success without inspecting error details.

summary.summary: Creates a new LoopResult with initialized state, empty iterations, and current timestamp
summary.docSummary: Factory constructor for LoopResult instances. Initializes empty iteration slice, unbroken status, and current time as start timestamp. Call at loop execution start.

summary.summary: Determines if the loop exited via break statement before natural completion
summary.docSummary: Returns true if loop terminated via break (BrokeAt >= 0). Indicates early termination before all iterations completed.

summary.summary: Checks if all iterations succeeded and the loop executed at least once
summary.docSummary: Returns true only when loop executed >= 1 iteration and all succeeded. Determines overall loop success from aggregate iteration results.

summary.summary: Returns the elapsed time since the workflow started, rounded to millisecond precision and formatted as a string. Provides human-readable execution duration tracking.
summary.docSummary: Returns the elapsed duration since the workflow began as a formatted string rounded to millisecond precision. Used for tracking workflow execution time in logs, metrics, and monitoring displays. Converts the internal StartedAt timestamp into a readable duration string.

summary.summary: Returns the loop iteration number as a 1-based index by incrementing the internal 0-based Index value. Provides user-friendly iteration numbering for display and control flow.
summary.docSummary: Returns the current loop iteration as a 1-based index, converting from internal 0-based indexing. Used in loop contexts to provide intuitive iteration numbering that matches user expectations (starting at 1 rather than 0).

summary.summary: Maps string strategy identifiers to ParallelStrategy enum values for parallel execution policies
summary.docSummary: Parses strategy identifiers like 'all_succeed', 'any_succeed', and 'best_effort' into strongly-typed ParallelStrategy constants. Provides default fallback for unrecognized values.

summary.summary: Converts ParallelStrategy enum value to string representation for serialization
summary.docSummary: Returns the string representation of a ParallelStrategy value for serialization and logging purposes.

summary.summary: Calculates elapsed time duration for a branch execution from start to completion
summary.docSummary: Computes the time duration between branch start and completion times. Used to measure branch execution time.

summary.summary: Evaluates whether a branch execution succeeded based on error state and exit code
summary.docSummary: Determines success of a branch execution. A branch succeeds if it has no error and exit code equals zero. Used in result aggregation logic.

summary.summary: Factory function that creates and initializes a new ParallelResult instance
summary.docSummary: Creates a new ParallelResult with initialized results map and start time. Entry point for tracking parallel branch execution outcomes.

summary.summary: Registers a branch result, updates success/failure counters, and captures the first error encountered
summary.docSummary: Adds a branch result to the parallel execution results collection. Updates success and failure counters, tracks the first error for later retrieval. Core method for result aggregation.

summary.summary: Checks if all branches in parallel execution succeeded without any failures
summary.docSummary: Returns true only if all branches succeeded and at least one branch was executed. Used to determine if entire parallel operation succeeded.

summary.summary: Checks if at least one branch in parallel execution succeeded
summary.docSummary: Returns true if any branch succeeded, regardless of failures in other branches. Used for partial success evaluation in best-effort scenarios.

summary.summary: Converts StepType to its string representation, implementing the Stringer interface.
summary.docSummary: Returns the string representation of a StepType value. Implements Go's Stringer interface for type conversion.

summary.summary: Validates RetryConfig parameters: MaxAttempts >= 1, backoff strategy validity, jitter within [0, 1], multiplier >= 0.
summary.docSummary: Validates all retry configuration constraints. Checks MaxAttempts is at least 1, Backoff strategy is recognized, Jitter is within valid bounds [0.0, 1.0], and Multiplier is non-negative. Returns first validation error encountered.

summary.summary: Validates that CallWorkflowConfig has a non-empty workflow name and non-negative timeout, returning an error if either constraint is violated.
summary.docSummary: Validates CallWorkflowConfig before workflow execution. Ensures workflow name is provided and timeout is non-negative. Returns error details for validation failures.

summary.summary: Returns the effective timeout for a workflow call, using the configured timeout if positive, otherwise falling back to a default value.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the effective timeout for workflow execution. Returns the configured timeout if positive, otherwise applies DefaultSubWorkflowTimeout for sensible defaults.

summary.summary: Factory function that creates a new SubWorkflowResult instance initialized with a workflow name, empty outputs map, and current timestamp for tracking execution start.
summary.docSummary: Factory function creating SubWorkflowResult instances for tracking subworkflow execution. Initializes workflow name, output map, and start time for duration and status tracking.

summary.summary: Calculates and returns the elapsed time between when the subworkflow started and completed execution.
summary.docSummary: Computes the duration of subworkflow execution by calculating the time difference between CompletedAt and StartedAt timestamps.

summary.summary: Returns true if the subworkflow completed without error, determined by checking if the Error field is nil.
summary.docSummary: Determines subworkflow execution success by checking for nil error. Provides a convenient predicate for workflow status evaluation.

summary.summary: Validates the template by checking that name and states are defined, and that all parameters have unique non-empty names. Returns an error if any constraint is violated.
summary.docSummary: Validates template configuration by checking required fields (name, states) and parameter constraints (uniqueness, non-empty names). Use before persisting or executing templates to ensure structural integrity.

summary.summary: Extracts and returns the names of all parameters marked as required within the template, enabling identification of mandatory configuration values.
summary.docSummary: Returns a list of required parameter names from the template. Use to identify which parameters must be provided before template execution or instantiation.

summary.summary: Builds and returns a map of parameter names to their default values from the template, enabling initialization with predefined fallback values.
summary.docSummary: Extracts default values for all parameters defined in the template. Use to initialize parameter configurations or provide fallback values during template instantiation.

summary.summary: Implements the error interface for CircularTemplateError by returning a formatted error message describing the detected circular reference and its chain.
summary.docSummary: The Error method satisfies Go's error interface for CircularTemplateError, returning a human-readable message that displays the detected circular reference chain in the template dependency graph.

summary.summary: Creates a TemplateValidator instance with computed execution order, step indexes, and parallel branch mapping for efficient workflow template and reference validation.
summary.docSummary: Initializes a TemplateValidator with precomputed execution order and lookup indexes. Essential entry point for all template validation operations.

summary.summary: Maps branch names to their parent parallel step identifiers for detecting concurrent execution conflicts.
summary.docSummary: Constructs the parallel branch hierarchy used for identifying concurrent execution and validating cross-branch references.

summary.summary: Orchestrates complete workflow validation by validating all steps in execution order and workflow hooks, accumulating errors and warnings.
summary.docSummary: Main validation entry point. Validates all workflow steps and lifecycle hooks, returning comprehensive validation results with all detected errors and warnings.

summary.summary: Validates workflow-level hooks for each lifecycle stage (start, end, error, cancel) by checking template references.
summary.docSummary: Validates all workflow-level lifecycle hooks, distinguishing error contexts where error references are permitted.

summary.summary: Validates command and log fields in hook actions as templates without step-level reference context.
summary.docSummary: Validates individual hook actions (command and log fields) by extracting template references. Used for both workflow and step hooks.

summary.summary: Validates a single step including command/dir templates, loop expressions, and pre/post hooks with forward-reference detection.
summary.docSummary: Comprehensive step validation covering templates (command, dir), loop configurations, and step lifecycle hooks. Detects forward references and parallel conflicts.

summary.summary: Validates all expressions within loop configurations (max_iterations, condition, items, break_condition).
summary.docSummary: Validates loop control expressions as templates with step-level reference context for proper forward-reference detection.

summary.summary: Parses template string to extract variable references, then routes each reference to type-specific validators.
summary.docSummary: Template parsing and validation gateway. Extracts all references from a template string and delegates validation to type-specific handlers.

summary.summary: Routes template reference validation to appropriate handler based on reference type (inputs, states, workflow, error, context, loop).
summary.docSummary: Reference type dispatcher. Routes references to specialized validators based on type, central routing point for all reference validation.

summary.summary: Validates input variable references, handling both simple references and arithmetic expressions with multiple input variables.
summary.docSummary: Validates input references with special parsing for arithmetic expressions. Detects undefined inputs in both simple and complex expressions.

summary.summary: Removes {{ }} delimiters from template expression strings for downstream parsing and validation.
summary.docSummary: String utility that strips template delimiters for expression content extraction.

summary.summary: Predicate determining if a string contains any arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /, %) or parentheses.
summary.docSummary: Character-level predicate for arithmetic operator detection in expression strings.

summary.summary: Validates all input variable names extracted from arithmetic expressions against defined workflow inputs.
summary.docSummary: Validates input references within arithmetic expressions. Tokenizes and checks each variable name for definition.

summary.summary: Parses arithmetic expressions to extract input variable names, handling both prefixed (inputs.name) and bare identifiers.
summary.docSummary: Expression tokenizer extracting input variable names. Handles prefixed names (inputs.x) and bare identifiers while filtering reserved namespaces.

summary.summary: Predicate checking if a name matches reserved namespace keywords (inputs, states, workflow, env, error, context).
summary.docSummary: Namespace keyword detector for filtering reserved names from variable extraction.

summary.summary: Tokenizes expression strings by splitting on operators and whitespace while preserving identifier boundaries.
summary.docSummary: Expression tokenizer splitting on arithmetic operators and whitespace for parsing variable references.

summary.summary: Validates identifier syntax: must start with letter or underscore, followed by alphanumeric or underscore characters.
summary.docSummary: Identifier syntax validator for variable name validation.

summary.summary: Character predicate determining if a rune is an ASCII letter (a-z, A-Z).
summary.docSummary: Character classification helper for identifier validation.

summary.summary: Character predicate determining if a rune is an ASCII digit (0-9).
summary.docSummary: Character classification helper for identifier validation.

summary.summary: Validates step state references including forward-reference detection, parallel-branch conflict detection, and property validation.
summary.docSummary: Step state reference validator. Enforces execution order constraints, detects concurrent branch conflicts, and validates output properties (.Output, .Stderr, etc).

summary.summary: Extracts step identifier from a path string (e.g., 'steps.stepname' → 'stepname').
summary.docSummary: Path parser extracting step name from qualified path strings.

summary.summary: Validates workflow property references against allowed properties, providing case-correction suggestions for common mistakes.
summary.docSummary: Workflow property validator with intelligent error suggestions for case mismatches (e.g., 'status' → 'Status').

summary.summary: Validates error property references, restricted to error hook contexts, with case-correction suggestions for common mistakes.
summary.docSummary: Error property validator for error hooks. Restricts error references to error contexts and suggests corrections for case mismatches.

summary.summary: Validates context property references against allowed properties, providing case-correction suggestions.
summary.docSummary: Context property validator with intelligent error suggestions for case mismatches.

summary.summary: Validates loop variable references against allowed loop properties.
summary.docSummary: Loop variable reference validator ensuring only valid loop properties are accessed.

summary.summary: Computes step execution order via BFS traversal from initial step, handling parallel branches and conditional transitions with cycle tolerance.
summary.docSummary: Topological sorter computing execution order for workflow steps. Uses BFS to traverse from initial step, handling parallel branches and conditional transitions.

summary.summary: Helper appending unvisited state to BFS queue during topological ordering, used in execution order computation.
summary.docSummary: BFS queue management helper for topological ordering. Enqueues unvisited states while maintaining visited set.

summary.summary: Creates a lookup map of input names from workflow inputs for O(1) reference validation.
summary.docSummary: Builds index for input name validation. Creates fast-lookup map from input definitions.

summary.summary: Creates a lookup map of step names from workflow steps for O(1) reference validation.
summary.docSummary: Builds index for step name validation. Creates fast-lookup map from step definitions.

summary.summary: Formats the validation error as a string, including severity level and optional path for display purposes.
summary.docSummary: Formats the validation error as a human-readable string with level and optional path. Used when displaying validation errors to users or logging.

summary.summary: Checks if this validation error has error-level severity (true if Level == ValidationLevelError).
summary.docSummary: Determines if this validation error represents a critical error (rather than a warning). Use this to branch on error severity.

summary.summary: Checks if the validation result contains any error-level issues.
summary.docSummary: Checks if the validation result contains any error-level issues. Call this before processing the result to determine if validation failed.

summary.summary: Checks if the validation result contains any warning-level issues.
summary.docSummary: Checks if the validation result contains any warning-level issues. Useful for distinguishing between critical errors and non-critical warnings.

summary.summary: Combines all validation errors and warnings into a single slice in errors-first order.
summary.docSummary: Returns all validation issues (errors and warnings) in a single slice. Use when processing all issues together regardless of severity level.

summary.summary: Records a new error-level validation issue with severity, code, path, and message.
summary.docSummary: Records a new error-level validation issue during validation. Accumulates errors with code, path, and message for later inspection.

summary.summary: Records a new warning-level validation issue with severity, code, path, and message.
summary.docSummary: Records a new warning-level validation issue during validation. Accumulates non-critical warnings with code, path, and message for reporting.

summary.summary: Converts a ValidationResult to Go's standard error interface, aggregating multiple errors or returning nil if valid.
summary.docSummary: Converts a ValidationResult to Go's standard error type. Returns nil if validation passed, or an aggregated error if validation contains errors.

summary.summary: Maps workflow step type names from plugin aliases to fully qualified names by splitting on '.' and resolving the prefix against the plugins map.
summary.docSummary: ResolveStepType resolves plugin type aliases to their fully qualified step type names. Given a type name with an optional plugin prefix (e.g., 'myPlugin.MyStep'), it returns the fully qualified name based on the workflow's plugin configuration.

summary.summary: Performs a map lookup to retrieve a Step from the workflow by name, returning the step pointer and a boolean indicating success.
summary.docSummary: GetStep retrieves a step definition from the workflow by its name. Returns the step pointer and a boolean success indicator using Go's comma-ok pattern for safe map access.

summary.summary: Generates context-specific human-readable error messages for workflow state reference validation failures by matching the error field and formatting descriptive text.
summary.docSummary: Error implements the error interface for StateReferenceError, providing human-readable messages indicating which workflow field references an unknown state and the context of the validation failure.

summary.summary: Performs comprehensive validation of workflow structure including required fields, plugin aliases, step existence, terminal state requirements, and loop/parallel branch integrity.
summary.docSummary: Validate checks the workflow for structural correctness and semantic validity. It validates required fields (name, initial state), plugin configurations, step existence and references, terminal state presence, and performs step-specific validation via the provided checker. This is the primary entry point for workflow validation.

summary.summary: Estimates token count by dividing text length by 4, providing a fast approximation when real tokenization is unavailable.
summary.docSummary: Approximates token count for text using a 4-character-per-token heuristic. Provides fast estimates when precise tokenization models are unavailable.

summary.summary: Sums character length across multiple conversation turns and divides by 4 to estimate total tokens consumed.
summary.docSummary: Estimates total tokens across multiple conversation turns by aggregating text lengths. Tracks cumulative token usage in multi-turn dialogs when precise tokenizers are unavailable.

summary.summary: Returns true to indicate this tokenizer provides estimated rather than actual token counts.
summary.docSummary: Identifies whether token counts are estimates or real values. Used to mark results with TokensEstimated flag when tokenizer output is approximate rather than real.

summary.summary: Returns 'fallback' to identify this as a fallback tokenizer implementation.
summary.docSummary: Identifies this tokenizer variant by name. Used for logging, debugging, and documenting which tokenizer implementation was used during execution.

summary.summary: Factory function constructing a baseCLIProvider with executor, logger, and fallback tokenizer, applying sensible defaults.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new CLI provider instance with default configurations. Initializes the provider with a fallback tokenizer and optional logger, serving as the entry point for CLI provider creation.

summary.summary: Concatenates stdout and stderr byte slices into a single string, merging both output streams.
summary.docSummary: Merges standard output and error streams into a single string result. Ensures all command output is captured in execution results regardless of stream source.

summary.summary: Checks if raw JSON output format is requested via the options map, returning true if output_format is 'json'.
summary.docSummary: Determines whether raw JSON output should bypass stream filtering. Used to decide if display event parsing applies or raw output is shown directly.

summary.summary: Conditionally wraps stdout with a StreamFilterWriter for parsing display events, based on hook availability and rawDisplay flag.
summary.docSummary: Applies optional stream filtering to stdout for real-time event parsing. Returns the wrapped writer and filter instance if filtering is enabled, enabling event-driven output processing.

summary.summary: Executes a CLI command with given prompt and options, streams output, counts tokens, and returns an AgentResult with timing and content information.
summary.docSummary: Executes a single CLI command and collects results. Primary method for non-conversational CLI operations, handling output aggregation, stream filtering, token estimation, and execution timing.

summary.summary: Executes a conversational CLI turn by managing conversation state, processing prompt with context history, and tracking input/output tokens across the multi-turn interaction.
summary.docSummary: Executes a conversational turn with full state management. Extends single-command execution to multi-turn dialogs, maintaining conversation history and token tracking across turns.

summary.summary: Constructor that creates a new ExecCLIExecutor for CLI command execution.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new ExecCLIExecutor instance for executing external CLI commands. This is the primary constructor used to initialize the executor with support for process group isolation, context cancellation, and automatic cleanup of child processes.

summary.summary: Executes external CLI commands with process group management, context cancellation support, and output capture to buffers and optional writers.
summary.docSummary: The primary method for executing external CLI commands with managed process groups and context cancellation. Spawns commands in isolated process groups, captures stdout and stderr to both internal buffers and optional writers, and automatically cleans up orphaned processes on timeout or cancellation.

summary.summary: Recursively terminates a process and all its descendants by traversing the process tree and sending SIGKILL signals.
summary.docSummary: Internal utility function that recursively terminates a process and all its child processes. Performs depth-first traversal of the process tree, killing each process with SIGKILL. Used as a fallback cleanup mechanism when standard process group termination fails to properly clean up children.

summary.summary: Scans /proc filesystem to discover child processes of a given parent PID by parsing stat files.
summary.docSummary: Internal helper function that discovers child processes by scanning the /proc filesystem and parsing stat entries. Locates all processes with a given parent PID, correctly handling command names containing spaces. Returns a list of child process IDs used by the process cleanup routines.

summary.summary: Constructs a ClaudeProvider instance with optional logger dependency injection
summary.docSummary: Factory function that creates a ClaudeProvider with optional dependency injection for logging capabilities. Initializes the provider with either the supplied logger or a NopLogger default.

summary.summary: Constructs a ClaudeProvider by applying functional options to configure behavior
summary.docSummary: Alternative constructor using the options pattern to configure ClaudeProvider with custom settings before use.

summary.summary: Initializes the base CLI provider with Claude-specific execution hooks and tokenizer configuration
summary.docSummary: Internal initialization layer that sets up the base CLI provider, configuring execution hooks, conversation hooks, and token management.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt through Claude CLI, extracts text from streamed JSON output, and returns structured result with optional JSON response
summary.docSummary: Sends a prompt to the Claude CLI and retrieves results. Parses NDJSON output to extract text content and optional JSON responses based on output format configuration.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt within a conversation session, preserving state and session continuity across multiple turns
summary.docSummary: Continues a Claude conversation using session state for multi-turn interactions. Extracts JSON responses from NDJSON output when explicitly requested by the user.

summary.summary: Returns the string identifier for this Claude provider
summary.docSummary: Identifies this provider as 'claude' for use in provider selection and routing within the workflow system.

summary.summary: Validates that the Claude CLI executable is available in the system PATH
summary.docSummary: Verifies provider prerequisites by checking for the claude command in PATH before execution, returning an error if not found.

summary.summary: Builds command-line arguments for Claude CLI prompt execution based on options
summary.docSummary: Transforms user options into Claude CLI flags, enforcing stream-json format for consistent output parsing across execute commands.

summary.summary: Builds CLI arguments for conversation execution, handling session resumption and system prompt injection
summary.docSummary: Generates Claude CLI flags for multi-turn conversations, managing session tokens for resumption and injecting system prompts on initial turns.

summary.summary: Validates that the model option follows Claude's naming conventions or recognized aliases
summary.docSummary: Ensures the model parameter is a valid Claude model identifier, accepting either known aliases (sonnet, opus, haiku) or official claude-* format.

summary.summary: Determines if a model string is a valid Claude model identifier
summary.docSummary: Validates model identifiers against known aliases and official naming patterns for use in option validation.

summary.summary: Extracts the result event object from Claude CLI's NDJSON output stream
summary.docSummary: Parses streaming JSON output line-by-line to locate and extract the final result event containing model response and metadata.

summary.summary: Extracts the session ID from Claude CLI output for conversation continuity
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the session identifier from result event metadata to enable resuming multi-turn conversations.

summary.summary: Extracts text content from the Claude result event, handling multiple result types with type coercion
summary.docSummary: Parses the result field from event JSON, converting strings and numeric values to displayable text format.

summary.summary: Parses token usage metrics and cost information from Claude API response metadata
summary.docSummary: Extracts input/output token counts including cache tokens and USD cost from the result event usage data.

summary.summary: Converts Claude assistant message JSON into display events, separating text and tool use blocks
summary.docSummary: Transforms streamed assistant messages into structured display events for UI rendering, parsing text content and tool invocation blocks with sanitization.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CodexProvider with default logger and executor, initializing the base CLI provider.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new CodexProvider instance with default configuration for standard Codex CLI operations.

summary.summary: Factory function creating CodexProvider with customizable options applied via option functions before base initialization.
summary.docSummary: Creates a CodexProvider with custom configuration options, enabling fine-grained control over provider behavior.

summary.summary: Initializes the base CLI provider with Codex-specific event parsing, argument building, and token extraction callbacks.
summary.docSummary: Sets up the underlying base CLI provider with Codex-specific hooks for event parsing and token extraction.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt via Codex CLI, aggregating display text for non-JSON outputs and calculating token estimates.
summary.docSummary: Executes a single prompt through Codex CLI, automatically formatting results and estimating token usage.

summary.summary: Executes a conversation turn via Codex CLI, managing session state for multi-turn agent interactions.
summary.docSummary: Executes a conversation turn through Codex CLI, maintaining session state for multi-turn interactions.

summary.summary: Returns the provider identifier string.
summary.docSummary: Returns the canonical provider name used for provider identification and routing.

summary.summary: Checks if Codex CLI is available in the system PATH.
summary.docSummary: Verifies the Codex CLI tool is installed and accessible in the system PATH before provider use.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for prompt execution, including JSON output flag and model/permission options.
summary.docSummary: Builds command-line arguments for single-prompt execution with JSON output and optional flags.

summary.summary: Builds CLI arguments for conversation, resuming sessions when available and inlining system prompts for new ones.
summary.docSummary: Constructs command-line arguments for conversation turns, handling session resumption and system prompt inlining.

summary.summary: Appends model and permission bypass options to CLI argument list based on provided options.
summary.docSummary: Adds optional Codex flags (model, permission bypass) to command-line arguments.

summary.summary: Extracts the thread.started NDJSON event from raw output containing session initialization data.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the thread.started event from NDJSON output for session identification.

summary.summary: Extracts session ID from thread.started event with validation and error handling.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the session ID from thread.started events with validation for proper session establishment.

summary.summary: Extracts input/output token counts from turn.completed NDJSON event for usage tracking.
summary.docSummary: Parses token usage metrics from turn.completed events for cost tracking and estimation.

summary.summary: Validates option values, ensuring model format matches Codex conventions (gpt-, codex-, o-series).
summary.docSummary: Validates provider options, particularly model identifier formats against Codex requirements.

summary.summary: Validates model string format against Codex conventions (gpt-, codex-, o-series prefixes).
summary.docSummary: Checks if a model identifier follows Codex naming conventions for valid model selection.

summary.summary: Parses NDJSON event lines into DisplayEvent objects, sanitizing NUL bytes and extracting content.
summary.docSummary: Converts NDJSON event streams into structured DisplayEvent objects for UI rendering and display.

summary.summary: Creates a new CopilotProvider with a noop logger and CLI executor for basic Copilot integration.
summary.docSummary: Factory function that initializes a CopilotProvider with default components. Use this for standard provider setup without custom configuration.

summary.summary: Creates a CopilotProvider with custom configuration applied through functional option functions.
summary.docSummary: Factory function using the functional options pattern to construct a CopilotProvider with customizable behavior. Use this for advanced configuration scenarios.

summary.summary: Initializes the baseCLIProvider with Copilot-specific hooks for command building, parsing, and token handling.
summary.docSummary: Internal method that constructs the underlying baseCLIProvider component with Copilot CLI integration hooks. Configures command building, output parsing, session management, and token extraction.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt via Copilot CLI, extracts text content from JSON output, and recalculates token counts.
summary.docSummary: Executes a single prompt request through the Copilot CLI, parsing NDJSON output to extract text content and optionally recalculating token estimates for accuracy.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt within a multi-turn conversation, managing session state for continuity across interactions.
summary.docSummary: Handles conversational prompts by executing requests while managing session state, enabling resumable multi-turn interactions with session tracking.

summary.summary: Returns the provider identifier string.
summary.docSummary: Returns the canonical provider name identifier used for routing and registration.

summary.summary: Verifies that the copilot CLI executable is available in the system PATH.
summary.docSummary: Validates provider availability by checking for the copilot CLI tool in the system PATH. Should be called during initialization to ensure the provider is usable.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for single-prompt execution, translating high-level options to Copilot CLI flags.
summary.docSummary: Builds the command-line argument list for executing a single prompt, converting provider options into Copilot CLI flags.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for conversation execution, supporting session resumption or first-turn initialization.
summary.docSummary: Builds the CLI argument list for multi-turn conversations, differentiating between resuming existing sessions and starting new conversations.

summary.summary: Appends Copilot-specific CLI options (model, mode, effort, tools, permissions) to the argument list.
summary.docSummary: Translates high-level provider options into Copilot CLI flags, appending them to build the final command-line arguments.

summary.summary: Converts dynamic values to string slices, handling []string and []any types for normalization.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that normalizes various input types to string slices for consistent CLI argument construction.

summary.summary: Validates that mode and effort options match allowed enumerated values.
summary.docSummary: Validates provider options against allowed values, ensuring mode and effort parameters conform to Copilot CLI constraints.

summary.summary: Parses NDJSON output to extract the Copilot session ID for multi-turn conversation resumption.
summary.docSummary: Extracts session identifiers from Copilot CLI NDJSON output, enabling session resumption for continuing conversations.

summary.summary: Extracts token usage metrics from assistant.message events in Copilot CLI output.
summary.docSummary: Parses token usage data from Copilot CLI output, providing token counts for quota tracking and billing.

summary.summary: Converts NDJSON output lines into structured DisplayEvent objects for UI rendering and streaming.
summary.docSummary: Parses streaming events from Copilot CLI output, converting NDJSON to DisplayEvent structures for real-time UI updates.

summary.summary: Extracts the final assistant message text from Copilot CLI NDJSON output stream.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves the final text content from Copilot CLI output, filtering NDJSON events and providing fallback behavior.

summary.summary: Constructor that creates a GeminiProvider with default CLI executor and initializes the base provider configuration.
summary.docSummary: Creates a GeminiProvider instance with default settings. This is the primary constructor for basic usage without custom configuration.

summary.summary: Constructor that creates a GeminiProvider with custom configuration options applied via functional parameters.
summary.docSummary: Creates a GeminiProvider with customizable options. Use this constructor when you need to configure the provider beyond defaults.

summary.summary: Initializes the base CLI provider with Gemini-specific hooks for command execution, conversation handling, and event parsing.
summary.docSummary: Internal method that wires the base CLI provider with Gemini-specific callbacks and tokenizer configuration. Called during provider initialization.

summary.summary: Validates Gemini provider options, ensuring the model name starts with the required 'gemini-' prefix.
summary.docSummary: Validates configuration options for Gemini provider. Checks that the model field, if present, uses a valid Gemini model name.

summary.summary: Checks if a model name is valid for Gemini by verifying it starts with 'gemini-' prefix.
summary.docSummary: Utility function to validate model name format. Returns true only for names beginning with 'gemini-'.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt against the Gemini CLI, aggregates streaming JSON output, extracts text content, and optionally parses JSON responses.
summary.docSummary: Primary execution interface for single-turn prompt interactions. Handles streaming output aggregation and optional JSON parsing. Estimated token counts are recomputed from aggregated output.

summary.summary: Executes a multi-turn conversation by delegating to the base provider's conversation execution with session management.
summary.docSummary: Interface for multi-turn conversation interactions. Maintains conversation state and session identity across multiple exchanges.

summary.summary: Returns the provider identifier string 'gemini'.
summary.docSummary: Returns the name of this provider for identification purposes.

summary.summary: Validates that the gemini CLI tool is available and executable in the system PATH.
summary.docSummary: Performs pre-flight validation to ensure the required Gemini CLI is installed and accessible. Should be called before executing any operations.

summary.summary: Prepends Gemini-specific global flags to CLI arguments based on options map (model, output format, permissions mode).
summary.docSummary: Utility to construct CLI argument lists with required Gemini flags. Handles model selection, output format, and permission overrides.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for executing a single prompt, forcing stream-json output format for consistent processing.
summary.docSummary: Builds command-line arguments for single-turn prompt execution. Ensures stream-json output format for reliable parsing downstream.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for multi-turn conversation, inlining system prompts on first turn or resuming existing sessions.
summary.docSummary: Builds command-line arguments for multi-turn interactions. Handles system prompt integration on initial turns and session resumption.

summary.summary: Extracts the 'init' event from NDJSON-formatted CLI output.
summary.docSummary: Utility to parse initialization events from streaming output. Used to extract session information and provider metadata.

summary.summary: Extracts and validates the session ID from the init event in Gemini CLI output, with comprehensive error handling.
summary.docSummary: Parses session identifiers from CLI responses for conversation continuity. Validates that session_id is present and non-empty.

summary.summary: Extracts input, output, and total token counts from the result event in Gemini CLI output.
summary.docSummary: Parses token usage statistics from API responses. Returns input tokens, output tokens, and total count for billing and monitoring.

summary.summary: Parses NDJSON message events from Gemini CLI into structured DisplayEvent objects, handling both text content and tool calls.
summary.docSummary: Converts raw CLI output events into internal display format. Processes assistant messages containing text and tool invocations for rendering.

summary.summary: Creates a deep copy of a ConversationState by cloning the Turns slice and copying scalar fields, enabling independent state manipulation without shared memory issues.
summary.docSummary: Produces an independent copy of a ConversationState for isolated state manipulation in concurrent or branching workflow scenarios. Essential for preventing unintended state mutations across execution paths.

summary.summary: Safely retrieves a string value from a dynamic options map with type assertion, returning empty string and false if the key is absent or not a string type.
summary.docSummary: Provides type-safe retrieval of string configuration options from dynamic map structures without panics. Used throughout the agent system for safe option parsing.

summary.summary: Constructs the initial conversation prompt by prepending an optional system prompt from configuration, or returns the user prompt alone if no system prompt is configured.
summary.docSummary: Assembles the first conversation turn prompt by conditionally prepending a system prompt from configuration options. Enables flexible system prompt injection for workflow initialization.

summary.summary: Safely extracts a boolean value from a dynamic options map with type assertion, returning false flags if the key is absent or not a boolean type.
summary.docSummary: Provides type-safe retrieval of boolean configuration options from dynamic map structures. Used for safe feature flag and configuration option parsing.

summary.summary: Attempts to parse a JSON object from unstructured string output, returning nil if input is not JSON-formatted or parsing fails, enabling graceful handling of malformed agent responses.
summary.docSummary: Robustly extracts JSON data from unstructured agent output, gracefully handling invalid or malformed JSON without panics. Critical for resilient response parsing in agent interactions.

summary.summary: Scans newline-delimited JSON lines to locate and return the first event matching the specified type, returning nil if not found.
summary.docSummary: Locates the first event of a given type in newline-delimited JSON streams, enabling event filtering in agent output processing. Used to extract initial state or first occurrence of streaming events.

summary.summary: Scans all newline-delimited JSON lines to find and return the last event matching the specified type, returning nil if not found.
summary.docSummary: Locates the final event of a given type in newline-delimited JSON streams, useful for extracting terminal states or aggregate results from streaming agent output.

summary.summary: Extracts an integer value from a map by converting JSON-parsed float64 values, returning 0 if the key is absent or value is not numeric.
summary.docSummary: Safely retrieves integer values from JSON-parsed maps, handling the float64 conversion that JSON unmarshaling produces for numeric values.

summary.summary: Truncates strings longer than 40 characters to 37 characters with an ellipsis suffix, preserving shorter strings unchanged for readable argument display.
summary.docSummary: Formats argument values for display by truncating long strings to a readable length with ellipsis indicator. Used in logging and UI rendering of function arguments.

summary.summary: Extracts a preview string from argument maps by checking predefined keys in order and returning the first string value found, truncated for display.
summary.docSummary: Generates concise argument previews for display by extracting and formatting relevant fields from parsed argument maps using priority key ordering.

summary.summary: Parses JSON argument strings and extracts a displayable preview by delegating to extractArgPreviewFromMap, returning empty string if JSON parsing fails.
summary.docSummary: Transforms JSON-formatted function arguments into concise, displayable preview strings for logging and UI presentation. Entry point for argument preview generation.

summary.summary: Constructs a new OpenAI-compatible provider instance with HTTP client and applies optional configuration.
summary.docSummary: Factory function that initializes an OpenAI-compatible LLM provider. Sets up the HTTP client and applies any provided configuration options for use with OpenAI-compatible APIs.

summary.summary: Returns the provider identifier "openai_compatible".
summary.docSummary: Returns the provider's unique name identifier used for logging and result attribution.

summary.summary: Validates provider configuration (currently a no-op).
summary.docSummary: Validates provider configuration state. Currently accepts all configurations; intended for future validation logic.

summary.summary: Executes a single-turn prompt against the OpenAI-compatible API, returning the result with token counts and optional JSON parsing.
summary.docSummary: Sends a prompt to the configured OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and returns the assistant's response. Supports optional JSON output formatting and token tracking for single-turn execution.

summary.summary: Unmarshals a JSON string response into a map.
summary.docSummary: Parses a JSON response string into a map for structured result handling. Used when output_format is set to JSON.

summary.summary: Executes a multi-turn conversation with state management, system prompts, and token tracking.
summary.docSummary: Manages stateful multi-turn conversations with the OpenAI-compatible API. Preserves conversation history, applies system prompts, and tracks input/output tokens per turn.

summary.summary: Writes formatted display output to a writer by extracting display text from events.
summary.docSummary: Outputs assistant response or tool-use events to stdout/display in human-readable format. Handles nil writers gracefully.

summary.summary: Parses configuration options from a map with environment variable fallbacks and validation.
summary.docSummary: Extracts and validates configuration options (base URL, model, API key, system prompt, temperature, tokens, top_p) with environment variable fallbacks for required fields.

summary.summary: Parses and validates temperature option, ensuring it's in the 0-2 range.
summary.docSummary: Extracts the temperature parameter from options and validates it falls within OpenAI's accepted range (0-2). Returns nil if not specified.

summary.summary: Parses max completion tokens with legacy max_tokens fallback and validation.
summary.docSummary: Extracts max token limit from options with backward compatibility for legacy max_tokens key. Validates non-negative values.

summary.summary: Parses and validates top_p (nucleus sampling) option, ensuring it's in the 0-1 range.
summary.docSummary: Extracts the top_p parameter for nucleus sampling and validates it's between 0 and 1. Returns nil if not specified.

summary.summary: Makes an HTTP POST request to the chat completions endpoint and parses the response.
summary.docSummary: Sends a chat completion request to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint with formatted messages and returns the parsed response. Handles context cancellation and HTTP error mapping.

summary.summary: Maps HTTP status codes to provider-specific error messages.
summary.docSummary: Translates HTTP response status codes into descriptive error messages for authentication, rate limiting, server, and client errors. Handles special cases like retry-after headers.

summary.summary: Translates OpenAI-compatible response chunks into DisplayEvent objects for text and tool use.
summary.docSummary: Converts OpenAI API response chunks (streaming or complete) into a unified DisplayEvent format for both text content and tool-call information.

summary.summary: Creates and returns a new OpenCodeProvider instance with default NopLogger and ExecCLIExecutor, then initializes the base provider.
summary.docSummary: Factory function that creates a new OpenCodeProvider with default settings. Use this to instantiate a basic OpenCodeProvider without custom configuration options.

summary.summary: Creates a new OpenCodeProvider, applies functional options for customization, and initializes the base provider.
summary.docSummary: Factory function that creates a new OpenCodeProvider with custom options applied. Pass OpenCodeProviderOption functions to configure logging, execution, or tokenization before initialization.

summary.summary: Initializes and returns a baseCLIProvider with OpenCode-specific hooks for argument building, conversation handling, session extraction, and event parsing.
summary.docSummary: Initializes the base CLI provider infrastructure with OpenCode-specific event handlers and parsing logic. Sets up the provider's core execution pipeline with hooks for custom behavior.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt via the base provider, aggregates NDJSON event text, and optionally parses JSON responses based on output_format option.
summary.docSummary: Executes a single prompt against the OpenCode provider. Handles NDJSON event aggregation, extracts human-readable display text, and parses JSON responses when output_format is 'json' or 'stream-json'.

summary.summary: Executes a prompt within a multi-turn conversation context, maintaining state and session continuity across turns.
summary.docSummary: Executes a prompt as part of a multi-turn conversation with state management. Maintains conversation history and session continuity, enabling stateful interactions across multiple exchanges.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for OpenCode execution, including model selection, forcing --format json, and logging unsupported permission flags.
summary.docSummary: Constructs the command-line arguments for OpenCode single execution. Always sets --format json for NDJSON streaming, adds model if specified, and logs unsupported dangerously_skip_permissions option.

summary.summary: Constructs CLI arguments for multi-turn conversation execution, handling first-turn prompt building, session ID propagation, and continuation flags.
summary.docSummary: Constructs command-line arguments for multi-turn conversation execution. Handles first-turn prompt formatting, session ID propagation via -s flag, and conversation continuation via -c flag when session ID is unavailable.

summary.summary: Appends OpenCode-specific CLI options (framework, verbose, output_dir) to the argument list if present in the options map.
summary.docSummary: Helper function that applies OpenCode-specific command-line options. Adds framework specification, verbose logging flag, and output directory configuration to the argument list.

summary.summary: Returns the string 'opencode' as the provider identifier.
summary.docSummary: Returns the provider's identifier name ('opencode') for logging and provider lookup operations.

summary.summary: Validates that the OpenCode CLI executable is available in the system PATH, returning an error if not found.
summary.docSummary: Validates that the OpenCode CLI tool is installed and available in the system PATH. Call this before using the provider to ensure the CLI is accessible for execution.

summary.summary: Validates that output_dir is a string and verbose is a boolean if either is provided in the options map.
summary.docSummary: Validates OpenCode-specific option types before execution. Ensures output_dir is a string and verbose is a boolean, returning an error for type mismatches.

summary.summary: Finds and returns the first step_start NDJSON event from output, or returns an error if not found.
summary.docSummary: Extracts the initial step_start event from NDJSON streamed output. Returns an error if no step_start event is found in the output.

summary.summary: Extracts the sessionID field from the step_start event, returning an error if missing or not a non-empty string.
summary.docSummary: Extracts the session ID from OpenCode execution output. Required for resuming multi-turn conversations with session continuation across disconnections.

summary.summary: Extracts input tokens, output tokens, total tokens, and USD cost from the step_finish NDJSON event if available.
summary.docSummary: Extracts token usage metrics and cost information from the step_finish event in streamed output. Returns nil if the event or token information is missing.

summary.summary: Parses JSON-encoded NDJSON event lines into DisplayEvent structures, sanitizing NUL bytes and extracting text or tool_use information based on event type.
summary.docSummary: Parses individual NDJSON event lines into DisplayEvent structures for consumption by display filters. Handles text and tool_use event types, sanitizing NUL bytes to prevent JSON parse errors.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a CLI executor into a ClaudeProvider for command execution.
summary.docSummary: Configures a ClaudeProvider's executor via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to specify how the Claude provider executes CLI commands.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a tokenizer into a ClaudeProvider for token counting.
summary.docSummary: Configures a ClaudeProvider's tokenizer via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize token counting behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a CLI executor into a GeminiProvider for command execution.
summary.docSummary: Configures a GeminiProvider's executor via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to specify how the Gemini provider executes CLI commands.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a tokenizer into a GeminiProvider for token counting.
summary.docSummary: Configures a GeminiProvider's tokenizer via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize token counting behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a CLI executor into a CodexProvider for command execution.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CodexProvider's executor via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to specify how the Codex provider executes CLI commands.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a logger into a CodexProvider for logging operations.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CodexProvider's logger via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize logging behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a tokenizer into a CodexProvider for token counting.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CodexProvider's tokenizer via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize token counting behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a CLI executor into an OpenCodeProvider for command execution.
summary.docSummary: Configures an OpenCodeProvider's executor via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to specify how the OpenCode provider executes CLI commands.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a logger into an OpenCodeProvider for logging operations.
summary.docSummary: Configures an OpenCodeProvider's logger via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize logging behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a tokenizer into an OpenCodeProvider for token counting.
summary.docSummary: Configures an OpenCodeProvider's tokenizer via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize token counting behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a CLI executor into a CopilotProvider for command execution.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CopilotProvider's executor via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to specify how the Copilot provider executes CLI commands.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a logger into a CopilotProvider for logging operations.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CopilotProvider's logger via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize logging behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects a tokenizer into a CopilotProvider for token counting.
summary.docSummary: Configures a CopilotProvider's tokenizer via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize token counting behavior.

summary.summary: Returns a functional option that injects an HTTP client into an OpenAICompatibleProvider for API communication.
summary.docSummary: Configures an OpenAICompatibleProvider's HTTP client via the functional option pattern. Use during provider initialization to customize HTTP client behavior for OpenAI-compatible API calls.

summary.summary: Creates a new AgentRegistry with an initialized empty provider map.
summary.docSummary: Factory constructor for AgentRegistry. Initializes a new registry ready to register and manage agent providers.

summary.summary: Registers an agent provider in the registry, preventing duplicate registrations with thread-safe locking.
summary.docSummary: Adds a new agent provider to the registry. Enforces uniqueness by provider name and is thread-safe for concurrent registration. Returns an error if a provider with the same name is already registered.

summary.summary: Retrieves a registered agent provider by name with thread-safe read access.
summary.docSummary: Looks up and returns an agent provider by its name. Uses read locking for thread-safe access. Returns an error if the provider is not found in the registry.

summary.summary: Returns a list of all registered provider names with thread-safe read access.
summary.docSummary: Enumerates all registered agent providers by name. Thread-safe read operation that snapshots current provider names at call time.

summary.summary: Checks if a provider with the given name is registered in the registry.
summary.docSummary: Determines whether an agent provider with the specified name is available in the registry. Thread-safe predicate check using read locking.

summary.summary: Registers a set of default agent providers and aggregates registration errors.
summary.docSummary: Bootstrap method that registers all built-in agent providers. Attempts registration of each default provider and collects any registration errors. Returns aggregated errors from all failed registrations, allowing partial success.

summary.summary: Initializes a StreamFilterWriter with an io.Writer and optional logger, applying sensible defaults (io.Discard, NopLogger) for nil values. Sets up a 4096-byte buffer for line processing.
summary.docSummary: Private constructor initializing the core StreamFilterWriter. Substitutes io.Discard for nil writers and NopLogger for missing loggers. Called by public factory functions NewStreamFilterWriter and NewStreamFilterWriterWithParser to establish shared baseline state.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a StreamFilterWriter configured with a parser and renderer for parsing and rendering display events from incoming stream data.
summary.docSummary: Constructs a StreamFilterWriter for event-driven stream processing. Use when you need to parse structured display events and render them before filtering. Combines base initialization with parser and renderer configuration.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a StreamFilterWriter configured with a custom extraction function for filtering and extracting relevant content from stream lines.
summary.docSummary: Constructs a StreamFilterWriter for line-based filtering. Use when you need custom extraction logic applied to each line. The extract function receives raw line bytes and returns filtered content or empty string to skip.

summary.summary: Implements io.Writer, buffering input data and processing complete lines via extraction or parsing. Handles oversized lines, routes output to inner writer, and returns total bytes written.
summary.docSummary: Core Write method implementing the io.Writer interface. Buffers incoming data, processes complete newline-delimited lines through either the extract function or parser, and writes results to the inner writer. Logs lines exceeding maxLineSize. Returns bytes written and errors.

summary.summary: Routes a single line to either the parser or extract function based on configuration, delegating to parseAndRenderLine or custom extraction as appropriate.
summary.docSummary: Internal dispatch function deciding whether to parse a line into events or apply custom extraction. Prioritizes parser over extract function. Invoked by Write and Flush for consistent line handling throughout the writer lifecycle.

summary.summary: Parses a line into DisplayEvents, optionally renders them, and writes extracted text to the inner writer. Logs and passes through oversized lines without extraction.
summary.docSummary: Parses a single line into DisplayEvent structures and processes results. If a renderer is configured, invokes it on parsed events before output. Writes extracted text events to inner writer. Oversized lines are logged and written verbatim without extraction.

summary.summary: Filters DisplayEvents for EventText kind and writes them to the inner writer, handling delta and non-delta text with different output strategies.
summary.docSummary: Materializes text content from DisplayEvent structures. Delta text is written directly; non-delta text uses extraction formatting with newlines. Used by parseAndRenderLine and Flush to output parsed event content.

summary.summary: Flushes remaining buffered data by processing it through the parser or extract function, writing results to the inner writer, and clearing the buffer.
summary.docSummary: Finalizes stream processing by handling any remaining buffered data. Applies the same parsing or extraction logic as Write to buffered content, writes results to inner writer, and clears the buffer. Must be called after all Write operations to ensure complete output.

summary.summary: Writes an extracted string to the inner writer followed by a newline, wrapping write errors with contextual information.
summary.docSummary: Outputs filtered text to the inner writer with trailing newline. Used by processLine and writeTextEvents to materialize extracted content. Wraps write errors with descriptive context for debugging.

summary.summary: Pure utility parsing raw multi-line text into DisplayEvents and extracting all EventText content, returning filtered text joined by newlines without side effects.
summary.docSummary: Extracts text content from raw multi-line input by parsing each line into DisplayEvents and collecting EventText entries. Returns filtered text with lines joined by newlines. Complementary pure utility to StreamFilterWriter for standalone event extraction.
