summary.docSummary: Sets up local AWF environment with required directory structure (.awf/workflows, .awf/prompts, .awf/scripts) and template configuration files. Called when 'awf init' is executed without the --global flag.

summary.summary: Initializes global AWF directories in XDG standard locations for prompts and scripts shared across all projects.
summary.docSummary: Creates global prompts and scripts directories in XDG standard locations ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/awf/prompts/ and $XDG_DATA_HOME/awf/scripts/). Invoked with 'awf init --global' flag.

summary.summary: Helper function that writes file content with specified permissions, safely skipping writes to existing files unless force flag is true.
summary.docSummary: Atomic file write operation that respects existing files. Used internally by all example and config creation functions to safely write templates without overwriting unless explicitly forced.

summary.summary: Creates .awf.yaml main configuration file with default log level and output format settings.
summary.docSummary: Initializes the primary AWF configuration file with sensible defaults (info log level, text output format). Automatically created as part of 'awf init' initialization sequence.

summary.summary: Creates example.yaml workflow file demonstrating basic AWF state machine workflow structure with a greeting step.
summary.docSummary: Generates a sample workflow file showing AWF's state-based workflow syntax and structure. Serves as a reference template for users creating their own workflows.

summary.summary: Creates .awf/config.yaml with commented workflow input template and security guidance against storing secrets.
summary.docSummary: Generates project-level workflow inputs configuration file. Developers can uncomment and populate default values for workflow parameters while security comments discourage secret storage.

summary.summary: Creates example.sh bash script demonstrating how to reference scripts from workflows using template variables and script_file feature.
summary.docSummary: Generates sample bash script with executable permissions and documentation on integration with AWF workflows via script_file references. Serves as template for user-created automation scripts.

summary.summary: Creates example.md markdown prompt file with usage guide for referencing prompts in workflow inputs via @prompts/ prefix.
summary.docSummary: Initializes sample prompt file demonstrating the @prompts/ prefix syntax for including reusable prompt templates in workflows. Documents best practices for organizing complex prompts and template variables.

summary.summary: Factory function constructing the root plugin CLI command with subcommands for listing, enabling, disabling, installing, updating, removing, searching, and verifying plugins.
summary.docSummary: Returns the top-level plugin command for the AWF CLI, providing access to all plugin management operations including discovery, installation, and configuration.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to list available plugins with optional filtering by operations, details, step types, or validators.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin list command, allowing users to discover plugins and their capabilities with optional detailed views of operations, step types, and validators.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to enable a named plugin by marking it for load and initialization on next execution.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin enable command for activating installed plugins.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to disable and shut down a named plugin, preventing it from loading on startup.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin disable command for deactivating installed plugins.

summary.summary: Executes plugin discovery and displays plugins with optional filtering by capabilities (operations, step types, validators), supporting both text and JSON output formats.
summary.docSummary: Core implementation of the plugin list command. Discovers all installed plugins and their capabilities, with filtering options for operations, step types, and validators. Supports JSON and text output.

summary.summary: Transforms plugin info into operation entries by applying a callback function to extract names and associate them with plugin origins.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that converts a list of plugins into operation entries by mapping plugin capabilities to names.

summary.summary: Filters plugins with validator capability and creates validator entries mapping plugin names to descriptions.
summary.docSummary: Extracts validator plugins from a list and formats them as ValidatorEntry objects for display.

summary.summary: Transforms plugin capabilities into individual CapabilityEntry records, mapping operations, step types, and validators to their originating plugins.
summary.docSummary: Aggregates all plugin capabilities into a flat list of capability entries for comprehensive discovery.

summary.summary: Activates a named plugin, persists the enabled state, and reports success or failure with appropriate output formatting.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin enable command. Initializes the plugin system, enables the specified plugin, and persists the change to the state store.

summary.summary: Deactivates a named plugin, persists the disabled state, and reports success or failure with appropriate output formatting.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin disable command. Disables the specified plugin and persists the change to the state store.

summary.summary: Sets up the plugin infrastructure for discovery-only operations, loading plugin manifests without initializing gRPC connections or starting plugins.
summary.docSummary: Initializes the plugin system in read-only discovery mode, suitable for listing and managing plugins without requiring full gRPC startup.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to download, verify, extract, and atomically install a plugin from a GitHub repository.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin install command for fetching and installing plugins from GitHub releases with version constraints and pre-release support.

summary.summary: Downloads a plugin from GitHub releases, verifies checksums, extracts the binary and manifest, and atomically installs to the plugins directory.
summary.docSummary: Implements the plugin install command. Handles GitHub release fetching, platform-specific asset selection, checksum verification, and atomic installation.

summary.summary: Filters releases by version constraint and prerelease flag, returning the first matching release or error if none found.
summary.docSummary: Resolves the appropriate release from a list based on semantic version constraints and prerelease filtering.

summary.summary: Searches release assets for a checksum file and returns its download URL.
summary.docSummary: Locates the checksum file URL within GitHub release assets for integrity verification.

summary.summary: Normalizes plugin names by removing the awf-plugin- prefix, converting full names to short names.
summary.docSummary: Utility function to convert full plugin repository names (e.g., awf-plugin-jira) to short names (e.g., jira).

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to update one plugin or all externally-installed plugins to latest compatible versions.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin update command for upgrading installed plugins with support for batch updates and prerelease selection.

summary.summary: Orchestrates plugin update by either updating a single named plugin or iterating through all external plugins when --all flag is set.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin update command. Coordinates single or batch updates of installed plugins based on command flags.

summary.summary: Locates installed plugin, retrieves source metadata, fetches latest release from GitHub, compares versions, and updates if newer version available.
summary.docSummary: Core update logic for a single plugin. Fetches the latest stable release from GitHub and updates the installation if a newer version is available.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to uninstall a plugin binary and manifest, with optional preservation of configuration and state.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin remove command for uninstalling plugins with support for keeping configuration data.

summary.summary: Uninstalls a plugin by shutting down its gRPC connection, removing its directory and binary, and optionally purging its state.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin remove command. Safely uninstalls plugins with validation against built-in plugins and optional state preservation.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to verify SHA-256 checksums of installed plugins individually or in batch, with update capability.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin verify command for validating installed plugin integrity using stored SHA-256 checksums.

summary.summary: Scans plugin directories to discover all installed plugins by checking for presence of plugin binaries.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that discovers all installed plugins by scanning plugin directories for plugin binaries.

summary.summary: Computes SHA-256 hash of plugin binary, compares to stored checksum, and optionally updates stored value when --update flag is set.
summary.docSummary: Verifies a single plugin's integrity by comparing its SHA-256 hash to the stored checksum, with optional update capability.

summary.summary: Verifies checksums of one or more plugins, collects results, persists updates if any checksums were recomputed, and reports failures.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin verify command. Orchestrates verification of specified or all installed plugins and persists updated checksums.

summary.summary: Factory function creating a CLI command to search GitHub for AWF plugins by topic or keyword with JSON output support.
summary.docSummary: Returns the plugin search command for discovering available plugins on GitHub by topic or keyword.

summary.summary: Queries GitHub API for repositories tagged with awf-plugin topic, optionally filtered by keyword, and displays results sorted by popularity.
summary.docSummary: Implementation of the plugin search command. Queries GitHub for available AWF plugins and displays results with optional keyword filtering.

summary.summary: Constructs a Cobra CLI command for resuming interrupted workflows, configuring metadata, flags for list display and input overrides, and routing between list and resume execution paths.
summary.docSummary: Creates the 'resume' CLI command enabling users to resume interrupted workflow executions. Supports listing resumable workflows via --list flag, specifying a workflow ID to resume, and overriding input parameters with --input flags. Entry point for all CLI resume operations.

summary.summary: Lists all resumable workflows from persistent state store, filters completed ones, calculates step completion progress metrics, and outputs results in JSON, table, or text format.
summary.docSummary: Displays all resumable workflows currently stored in the system. Loads workflow execution states, filters incomplete workflows, calculates progress showing completed step counts, and renders output according to configured format preference. Invoked via 'awf resume --list'.

summary.summary: Executes workflow resumption by parsing CLI input overrides, establishing context with signal handling, initializing core services, loading project configuration, and merging input parameters.
summary.docSummary: Core handler for resuming a saved workflow execution state. Parses input overrides, establishes cancellation context with signal handling for graceful interruption, initializes required services including state store and shell executor, loads project configuration, and merges CLI inputs with project defaults.

summary.summary: Constructor that initializes an App instance with the given configuration and output formatter for CLI operations.
summary.docSummary: Creates and initializes an App instance with configuration and formatted output capabilities. Use this constructor to prepare the application with the desired configuration and output settings.

summary.summary: Factory function that constructs the root Cobra CLI command with global configuration flags, pre-execution hooks for migrations and format parsing, and registers subcommands for the AWF tool.
summary.docSummary: Initializes the root CLI command for the AI Workflow Framework with global flags (verbose, quiet, output format), pre-run hooks for configuration validation and migration detection, and orchestrates subcommand registration. Entry point for CLI initialization.

summary.summary: Creates a Cobra command that displays the application version, git commit hash, and build date when invoked.
summary.docSummary: Constructs the 'version' subcommand for displaying build metadata including version number, commit hash, and build timestamp. Useful for tracking deployed application versions in production environments.

summary.summary: Initializes the plugin system by setting up search paths, state storage, loading built-in plugins, and returning configured managers for the plugin infrastructure.
summary.docSummary: Entry point for plugin system initialization. Configures plugin discovery paths, state storage, registers built-in plugins, and provides managers for runtime plugin operations including RPC, service, and event publishing.

summary.summary: Resolves plugin search directories from configuration, using custom paths if specified or falling back to built-in defaults.
summary.docSummary: Determines the directories to search for plugins. Returns custom paths from configuration if set, otherwise provides default system plugin paths for discovery.

summary.summary: Filters a list of paths to only those that exist on the filesystem as directories.
summary.docSummary: Validates and filters filesystem paths. Used to ensure only accessible directories are used in plugin discovery workflows.

summary.summary: Returns the first existing directory from a list of candidate paths.
summary.docSummary: Selects the first available directory from candidates. Simplifies path resolution when multiple fallback locations are possible.

summary.summary: Locates a plugin directory within search paths by trying both full and abbreviated plugin names.
summary.docSummary: Searches for a plugin installation directory using flexible name matching. Accommodates both full plugin identifiers and short names in the search process.

summary.summary: Resolves the correct plugin state key name by checking if full or abbreviated names exist in the state store.
summary.docSummary: Maps plugin names to their state store keys. Handles name resolution by checking both full and short forms to locate persisted plugin configuration.

summary.summary: Registers built-in plugins (GitHub, Notifications, HTTP) with their operations into the plugin service.
summary.docSummary: Configures core system plugins for GitHub operations, notifications, and HTTP requests. Must be called during plugin system initialization to enable built-in functionality.

summary.summary: Constructs Cobra CLI command for workflow execution supporting dry-run, interactive, and single-step modes with parameterized routing.
summary.docSummary: The run command is the main entry point for executing workflows. It supports multiple execution modes: standard (sequential), dry-run (plan preview), interactive (step-by-step with prompts), and single-step (isolated step testing). Input parameters are provided via --input flags with optional @prompts/ file references.

summary.summary: Higher-order function returning a help renderer that loads workflows and displays formatted help with parameters and examples.
summary.docSummary: Provides dynamic help generation for specific workflows. Loads workflow definitions from the repository, parses workflow namespaces (pack/name format), and renders formatted help including examples and available parameters. Falls back to standard help if workflow not found.

summary.summary: Main workflow execution handler initializing logging, signal handling, state storage, and coordinating execution services with output formatting.
summary.docSummary: Executes a workflow sequentially with real-time output handling. Initializes state storage, shell executor, and logging infrastructure. Supports output modes (silent, streaming, buffered), signal handling for graceful cancellation, and project configuration merging. Produces execution context with step results.

summary.summary: Generates execution plan and validates workflow without executing shell commands, including expression evaluation and template expansion.
summary.docSummary: Performs dry-run execution to preview workflow behavior. Validates workflow structure, template expansion, expression evaluation, and step ordering without executing shell commands. Useful for debugging workflow logic and verifying configuration before actual execution.

summary.summary: Executes workflow with step-by-step prompts and optional breakpoints for user-guided execution and debugging.
summary.docSummary: Interactive workflow execution mode that pauses at each step (or specified breakpoints) and prompts user for confirmation. Allows step skipping, viewing outputs, and branching. Useful for debugging, learning workflows, or manual approval gates in automation pipelines.

summary.summary: Converts key=value input flags into a map, resolves @prompts/ file references for parameter values.
summary.docSummary: Parses workflow input parameters from command-line flags. Expects key=value format with space trimming. Supports @prompts/ prefix to load input values from file paths, enabling cleaner CLI invocations and secure sensitive data handling.

summary.summary: Resolves @prompts/ prefixed strings to file content with path traversal and absolute path security checks.
summary.docSummary: Helper for loading input values from files using @prompts/ syntax. Validates file paths to prevent directory traversal attacks. Delegates to path-based resolution to search multiple configured prompt directories.

summary.summary: Searches multiple configured paths for a prompt file and returns trimmed file content with directory validation.
summary.docSummary: Locates and reads prompt files across multiple search paths in priority order. Validates that resolved path is a file (not directory). Provides detailed error messages listing all searched paths if file not found.

summary.summary: Formats and displays execution status, step completion order, and step durations to console.
summary.docSummary: Diagnostic output helper that displays overall execution status and per-step timing information. Used for verbose execution reporting to show workflow progress and performance metrics.

summary.summary: Returns step's display output if available, otherwise returns regular output field.
summary.docSummary: Accessor for step output with fallback. Returns DisplayOutput if set, otherwise returns Output field. Used by output formatters to show most relevant output representation.

summary.summary: Iterates over execution context and displays each step's stdout, stderr, and completion status.
summary.docSummary: Formats and displays step execution outputs including stdout, stderr, and success indicators for completed steps. Part of result presentation layer that converts execution context to human-readable form.

summary.summary: Displays success indicators for completed steps that produced no stdout or stderr output.
summary.docSummary: Ensures visibility of completed steps that don't produce output. Displays step success indicators even when stdout/stderr are empty, preventing silent completions from appearing invisible to users.

summary.summary: Transforms execution context step states into structured StepInfo objects with standardized output fields.
summary.docSummary: Converts internal step state representation to output-ready StepInfo structs containing name, status, outputs, timing, and errors. Used by JSON and structured output formatters.

summary.summary: Determines exit code by checking StructuredError first, then falling back to error message pattern matching.
summary.docSummary: Translates errors into appropriate exit codes for shell integration. First checks for StructuredError with embedded exit codes, then falls back to string pattern matching. Enables proper shell error handling and scripting integration.

summary.summary: Implements error interface, returns wrapped error message from exitError struct.
summary.docSummary: Error interface implementation for exitError type. Returns the underlying error message for logging and display.

summary.summary: Accessor method returning exit code from exitError struct.
summary.docSummary: Returns the exit code associated with the error for use in program termination and shell integration.

summary.summary: Accessor returning boolean indicating whether error was already handled to prevent duplicate reporting.
summary.docSummary: Indicates whether this error has already been reported to the user, preventing duplicate error output in error handling chains.

summary.summary: Serializes error to output writer and returns exitError to signal controlled program termination.
summary.docSummary: Error finalization function that outputs errors to configured output writer (JSON or text format) and returns exitError to trigger controlled program exit. Combines error reporting with exit code propagation.

summary.summary: Logs debug-level message only when verbose mode enabled and not in silent mode, with context merging.
summary.docSummary: Conditional debug logging for CLI logger. Merges context fields with message and delegates to formatter. Respects verbose and silent flags to control verbosity.

summary.summary: Logs info-level message with merged context fields, respects silent mode.
summary.docSummary: Standard info-level logging for CLI logger. Formats message with context fields and delegates to formatter. Skipped in silent mode.

summary.summary: Logs warning-level message with merged context fields, respects silent mode.
summary.docSummary: Warning-level logging for CLI logger. Merges context with message and delegates to formatter's Warning method. Skipped in silent mode.

summary.summary: Returns new logger instance with merged context maps, combining current and provided context (new values override).
summary.docSummary: Context-aware logger factory. Creates new logger with combined context from current and provided maps (new values override existing). Enables context propagation through logger chains.

summary.summary: Combines logger's context map with key-value array, preserving existing context and appending new pairs.
summary.docSummary: Helper that merges internal logger context with additional key-value pairs. Returns combined slice for passing to formatter. Handles empty context efficiently.

summary.summary: Converts message and key-value pairs into space-separated string with key=value formatting.
summary.docSummary: Log formatter that produces structured output from message and context fields. Each context value is formatted as key=value and space-separated from message and other values.

summary.summary: Executes isolated single step from workflow with mock state values for dependencies, history store, and plugin initialization.
summary.docSummary: Single-step execution mode for testing and debugging. Executes specified workflow step in isolation with ability to mock upstream step outputs. Initializes full service stack including history store and optional plugin system.

summary.summary: Parses command-line mock flags in key=value format into string map for step dependency mocking.
summary.docSummary: Parses mock value syntax (key=value) for single-step execution. Mock values override upstream step outputs to enable isolated step testing. Similar to input parsing but stores as strings.

summary.summary: Loads and parses project configuration from .awf/config.yaml in XDG config directory.
summary.docSummary: Loads project-level configuration containing inputs, templates, notification backends, and other settings. Uses standard XDG paths for cross-platform consistency.

summary.summary: Validates whether all required workflow inputs have been provided in the inputs map.
summary.docSummary: Validation helper that checks if any required inputs from workflow definition are missing from provided inputs. Used to trigger interactive collection if needed.

summary.summary: Checks for missing required inputs and interactively prompts user if running in terminal, returning merged inputs or error.
summary.docSummary: Input collection coordinator. If required inputs are missing and stdin is a terminal, prompts user to provide values. Returns error if inputs missing and non-interactive. Merges collected inputs with provided inputs.

summary.summary: Determines if an io.Reader is connected to a terminal (TTY).
summary.docSummary: Terminal detection helper. Checks if provided reader is an os.File connected to a TTY. Used to determine whether interactive prompts are available.

summary.summary: Establish OS signal handlers (SIGINT/SIGTERM) for graceful shutdown, invoking a callback and canceling context when signals arrive.
summary.docSummary: Sets up signal handling for graceful CLI shutdown. When SIGINT (Ctrl+C) or SIGTERM signals are received, it executes an optional callback and cancels the provided context. Returns a cleanup function to stop signal monitoring.

summary.summary: Renders help text for a workflow, displaying its description and formatted input parameters table to the output writer.
summary.docSummary: RenderWorkflowHelp outputs formatted help information for a workflow. It displays the workflow's description and a tabulated list of input parameters (name, type, required status, default value, description), supporting colored or plain output.

summary.summary: Transforms a workflow's input definitions into a slice of UI InputInfo structures for presentation.
summary.docSummary: Converts workflow domain model inputs into UI-layer InputInfo objects. Handles nil workflows and empty input lists by returning empty slices, and maps input metadata (name, type, required, default, description) for downstream formatting.

summary.summary: Converts any value to its string representation, returning an empty string for nil values.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that safely converts arbitrary values to strings using fmt.Sprintf. Returns empty string for nil inputs.

summary.summary: Formats and writes a table of input parameters to an output writer using tabwriter for aligned columns.
summary.docSummary: Writes a formatted table of input parameters to the provided output writer. Uses tabwriter for column alignment and includes headers for name, type, required status, default value, and description. Outputs 'No input parameters' message if the inputs list is empty.

summary.summary: Returns a dash if the value is empty, otherwise returns the value as-is for display in parameter tables.
summary.docSummary: Formats default parameter values for display. Returns '-' for empty values and the original value otherwise.

summary.summary: Converts a boolean required flag to human-readable 'yes' or 'no' string for display.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that converts a boolean required flag to human-readable text ('yes' or 'no') for parameter display.

summary.summary: Trims whitespace from description strings and returns 'No description' placeholder for empty descriptions.
summary.docSummary: Formats description strings for display by trimming whitespace. Returns 'No description' placeholder text when descriptions are empty or whitespace-only.

summary.summary: Renders a sequence of display events to an output writer, selecting text or formatted tool markers based on event type and verbosity mode.
summary.docSummary: The RenderEvents function outputs formatted display events from agent execution. It writes text events directly to the output stream and conditionally renders tool use markers in verbose mode, providing controlled visibility of agent tool invocations in CLI output.

summary.summary: Formats tool invocation markers with optional arguments, truncating long arguments with ellipsis to respect length constraints.
summary.docSummary: The formatToolMarker function creates a formatted display string for tool invocations. It handles three cases: tools with no arguments display as [tool: name], tools with arguments display as [tool: name(arg)], and oversized arguments are truncated with ellipsis to stay within display limits.

summary.summary: Constructs and returns a Cobra CLI command for displaying workflow execution status with support for verbose output and exit code handling.
summary.docSummary: Creates a Cobra command that allows users to query the current status of a workflow execution. The command accepts a workflow ID and displays execution state, progress, and step details with optional verbose mode.

summary.summary: Loads workflow execution state from storage and displays it in the specified output format (JSON, table, quiet, or text), handling errors and formatting appropriately.
summary.docSummary: The entry point for the status command. Retrieves workflow execution context from persistent storage, transforms it to appropriate output format, and writes it to stdout or stderr with error handling.

summary.summary: Transforms an internal ExecutionContext into a public ExecutionInfo struct by formatting timestamps to RFC3339 and calculating total execution duration.
summary.docSummary: Converts the internal workflow execution state representation into a format suitable for display and serialization. Handles timestamp formatting, duration calculation, and step metadata collection.

summary.summary: Formats and prints workflow execution status to stdout with color-coded output, progress tracking, and conditional verbose details including step logs and inputs.
summary.docSummary: Renders workflow execution status in human-readable text format with optional verbose mode. Displays workflow header, execution duration, progress metrics, and step details with color formatting.

summary.summary: Initializes a Colorizer with color formatters for different output types (success, error, warning, info, bold, dim), optionally disabling colors.
summary.docSummary: Factory function that creates a Colorizer instance for terminal output formatting. Initializes color styles for success (green), error (red), warning (yellow), info (cyan), plus bold and dim variants. Can disable colors entirely via the enabled flag.

summary.summary: Applies green color formatting to a string for success messages.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with green color to indicate successful output or completion status.

summary.summary: Applies red color formatting to a string for error messages.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with red color to indicate error conditions or failure status.

summary.summary: Applies yellow color formatting to a string for warning messages.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with yellow color to indicate warning conditions that need user attention.

summary.summary: Applies cyan color formatting to a string for informational messages.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with cyan color for informational output or status updates.

summary.summary: Applies bold text formatting to a string.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with bold styling for emphasis in terminal output.

summary.summary: Applies dim/faint text formatting to a string.
summary.docSummary: Formats a string with dim/faint styling for de-emphasized output, typically used for secondary information.

summary.summary: Applies color formatting to text based on a status string (completed=green, running=cyan, failed=red, pending=dim, cancelled=yellow).
summary.docSummary: Conditionally applies color formatting based on status value. Routes to appropriate color formatter: completed (green), running (cyan), failed (red), pending (dim), cancelled (yellow). Returns unformatted text for unknown statuses.

summary.summary: Constructs a DryRunFormatter with an output writer and color preference, initializing a colorizer for terminal formatting.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new DryRunFormatter instance for rendering dry-run workflow plans. Accepts an output writer and a color preference flag to control terminal output formatting.

summary.summary: Formats a complete dry-run workflow plan by sequentially rendering header, all steps, and footer sections to the configured output writer.
summary.docSummary: The primary entry point for formatting a DryRunPlan into human-readable text. Orchestrates the formatting pipeline by rendering the plan header, iterating through and formatting each workflow step, and appending a footer message. Returns an error if any formatting step fails.

summary.summary: Renders the header section of a dry-run plan including title, description, workflow inputs with defaults, and execution plan section header.
summary.docSummary: Formats the header section of the dry-run output. Includes the workflow name as title, optional description, all workflow inputs with their current values and default indicators, and the execution plan section header. Inputs are sorted for consistent output.

summary.summary: Renders a single workflow step with comprehensive detail including header, description, type-specific formatting, hooks, timeout, retry, capture, and transitions.
summary.docSummary: Formats a single workflow step for display in the dry-run output. Renders step header, description, type-specific details (parallel branches, loop configuration, agent settings), execution parameters (timeout, retry, capture, continue-on-error), and state transitions. Uses helper methods for consistent field formatting.

summary.summary: Renders the step header with type-specific labels and styling, displaying step name, index, or status depending on the step type.
summary.docSummary: Renders the header line for a workflow step with type-specific formatting. Terminal steps show success/failure status, parallel and loop steps display their names, and regular command steps show their index number. All headers are rendered in bold.

summary.summary: Dispatches formatting logic to type-specific handlers for parallel steps, loops, agents, and other specialized step types.
summary.docSummary: Routes step details formatting to specialized handlers based on step type. Handles parallel branches, loop configurations, agent settings, and other step-specific properties. Acts as a dispatcher to maintain separation of concerns.

summary.summary: Renders all pre- and post-execution hooks with appropriate formatting, distinguishing between log and other hook types.
summary.docSummary: Formats workflow step hooks for display. Renders both pre and post-execution hooks with type-specific formatting (log hooks are quoted, others are displayed as-is). Each hook is labeled with its execution phase.

summary.summary: Renders workflow state transitions with colored arrows and labeled conditions or types, showing which step follows based on success or failure.
summary.docSummary: Formats workflow state transitions for display. Uses colored arrows (green for success, red for failure) and renders either condition-based transitions or type-labeled transitions (default, on_success, on_failure). Shows the target step name for each transition.

summary.summary: Renders loop step configuration including loop type, iteration items or condition, loop body, max iterations, break condition, and completion handler.
summary.docSummary: Formats loop-specific properties for for-each and while loops. Displays loop type, items or condition, loop body steps, maximum iteration limits, break conditions, and post-completion behavior. Structured to clearly show loop control flow.

summary.summary: Renders parallel execution step configuration including branch names, execution strategy, and concurrency limits.
summary.docSummary: Formats parallel step configuration for display. Shows the branches being executed in parallel, the concurrency strategy, and maximum concurrent execution limit. Helps visualize parallel workflow structure.

summary.summary: Renders agent execution step details including provider, resolved prompt, CLI command, configuration options, and timeout settings.
summary.docSummary: Formats agent step properties for display. Shows the agent provider, resolved prompt text, optional CLI command override, agent configuration options, and execution timeout. Uses helper methods to conditionally render fields.

summary.summary: Writes a footer message with success-styled OK label informing the user that no commands will execute in dry-run mode.
summary.docSummary: Renders the footer section of the dry-run output. Displays a prominent success message indicating that no commands will be executed, reinforcing the non-destructive nature of the dry-run preview.

summary.summary: Returns concise display labels for different step types (parallel, terminal, loops, agent) for rendering in step headers.
summary.docSummary: Maps workflow step types to their display labels. Used internally to render type-specific prefixes in step headers. Returns empty string for regular command steps, and bracketed labels for specialized step types (parallel, terminal, agent, loops).

summary.summary: Constructs a DryRunFormatter instance with explicit output writer parameter, enabling custom output destinations for dry-run formatting.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new DryRunFormatter with an explicit writer parameter. This is an alternative constructor to NewDryRunFormatter, providing the same initialization with a named parameter approach.

summary.summary: Conditionally writes a labeled field to output if the value is non-empty, using consistent 4-space indentation for clean formatting.
summary.docSummary: Helper method for formatting labeled fields with consistent indentation. Skips empty values to avoid cluttering output. Used throughout the formatter for consistent field rendering with the pattern "label: value".

summary.summary: Conditionally writes a labeled integer field with optional unit suffix if the value is positive, skipping zero or negative values.
summary.docSummary: Helper method for formatting integer fields with units. Only renders fields with positive values, automatically appending the unit suffix. Used for timeout and other numeric parameters that should not display if unset or zero.

summary.summary: Writes retry configuration (max attempts and backoff strategy) if the retry policy is set, otherwise skips output.
summary.docSummary: Helper method for formatting retry policy configuration. Displays the maximum attempt count and backoff strategy in a human-readable format. Skips output if no retry policy is configured.

summary.summary: Formats output stream capture configuration if present, displaying which streams are captured and where they are redirected.
summary.docSummary: Helper method for formatting output capture configuration. Shows where stdout and stderr are being captured or redirected. Uses consistent syntax (stream -> destination) and orders output streams as stdout before stderr.

summary.summary: Renders agent configuration options in a sorted, indented list format with consistent key-value presentation.
summary.docSummary: Helper method for formatting agent configuration options. Displays all options in sorted order with additional indentation (6 spaces) to distinguish them from other step properties. Renders options as key-value pairs for clear readability.

summary.summary: Factory function that creates a Formatter instance with specified output destination and formatting options, initializing a colorizer based on color preferences.
summary.docSummary: NewFormatter constructs a CLI formatter for structured output. Configure the output writer and formatting preferences (quiet, verbose, color) via parameters to control message display behavior.

summary.summary: Prints formatted output to the underlying writer using fmt.Fprintf with the given format string and arguments.
summary.docSummary: Printf writes formatted strings to the output writer. Errors are silently discarded. Use for flexible formatting with standard format specifiers.

summary.summary: Prints arguments to the underlying writer with a trailing newline.
summary.docSummary: Println writes values and a newline to the output writer. Errors are silently discarded. Use for simple line-based output.

summary.summary: Prints an info message to the output, unless the formatter is configured in quiet mode.
summary.docSummary: Info outputs informational messages to stdout. Messages are suppressed when quiet mode is enabled. Use for standard application feedback.

summary.summary: Prints a debug message with dimmed styling applied, only when verbose mode is enabled.
summary.docSummary: Debug outputs debug-level messages with reduced visual emphasis. Messages appear only when verbose mode is active. Used for development and troubleshooting.

summary.summary: Prints a success message with green or success-level coloring applied.
summary.docSummary: Success outputs success messages with styled formatting (typically green). Always prints regardless of quiet or verbose settings.

summary.summary: Prints an error message with red or error-level coloring applied.
summary.docSummary: Error outputs error messages with styled formatting (typically red). Always prints regardless of quiet or verbose settings.

summary.summary: Prints a warning message with warning-level coloring, unless the formatter is in quiet mode.
summary.docSummary: Warning outputs warning messages with styled formatting. Messages are suppressed when quiet mode is enabled. Use for alerts and non-critical issues.

summary.summary: Prints a formatted step completion message with a checkmark symbol and success styling, respecting quiet mode.
summary.docSummary: StepSuccess displays a step completion notification with a checkmark symbol and success styling. Suppressed in quiet mode. Used in progress reporting.

summary.summary: Renders a formatted table with bold headers, separator line, and tab-aligned rows using tabwriter.
summary.docSummary: Table outputs tabular data with aligned columns. Headers are bolded and preceded by a separator. Rows are tab-separated and automatically aligned for readability.

summary.summary: Prints a formatted status line with a fixed-width label, colored status indicator, and detail message.
summary.docSummary: StatusLine displays a single status indicator with label, status value, and optional detail. Useful for reporting key-value status pairs in consistent format.

summary.summary: Returns the internal colorizer instance for direct color styling operations.
summary.docSummary: Colorizer provides access to the formatter's internal colorizer for custom color styling. Use to apply formatting outside standard message methods.

summary.summary: Constructor that initializes a CLIInputCollector with buffered reader, writer, and colorizer for CLI input collection
summary.docSummary: Constructor for CLIInputCollector. Sets up buffered I/O infrastructure for interactive command-line input prompts

summary.summary: Displays input prompt, reads user input in loop, validates against type/enum/pattern constraints, returns coerced value or error; continues until valid input or context cancelled
summary.docSummary: Collects and validates user input through interactive CLI prompts with type coercion, enum selection, pattern matching, and re-prompting on invalid input

summary.summary: Writes formatted input prompt to output showing field name, type, required status, description, default value, and enum options
summary.docSummary: Renders a formatted input prompt displaying field metadata, type information, requirement status, description, default value, and available options

summary.summary: Converts string input to target type (integer, boolean, string) with type-specific validation and error handling
summary.docSummary: Type-coerces string input to the requested type supporting integers, booleans, and string passthrough with format validation

summary.summary: Validates input against rules including 10MB size limit, regex pattern with ReDoS protection, numeric min/max, and file existence with path traversal prevention
summary.docSummary: Comprehensive input validation supporting size constraints, regex matching with ReDoS timeout protection, numeric ranges, and secure file-existence checks with path-traversal safeguards

summary.summary: Writes error message to output writer
summary.docSummary: Utility for displaying error messages to the user via the configured output writer

summary.summary: Returns true if target string is found in slice, false otherwise; performs linear search
summary.docSummary: Utility function checking string slice membership through linear search

summary.summary: Creates a new CLIPrompt instance with buffered input reader, output writer, and color support configuration for interactive CLI sessions.
summary.docSummary: Constructor for CLIPrompt that initializes buffered I/O streams and color formatting. Use this to create a new interactive CLI prompt handler for workflow management.

summary.summary: Displays a formatted header with the workflow name, using colored text and separator lines for visual hierarchy in interactive mode.
summary.docSummary: Renders the interactive mode header with the workflow name. Provides visual separation and indicates the start of interactive workflow execution.

summary.summary: Outputs detailed information about a workflow step including its index, type, command, timeout, and transition options.
summary.docSummary: Presents step details to the user, including step number, type, command being executed, timeout value, and available transition paths.

summary.summary: Continuously prompts the user for an action (continue, skip, abort, inspect, edit, retry) until a valid input is received or context cancels.
summary.docSummary: Interactive prompt that repeatedly requests a user action for step execution control. Validates input and returns the selected action or an error if the context is cancelled.

summary.summary: Displays a visual indicator that a specific step is currently executing with a separator line.
summary.docSummary: Shows that a step has started execution. Provides visual feedback during workflow run with a step name and separation line.

summary.summary: Displays the complete result of a step execution including output, error messages, exit code, duration, status indicator, and next step transition.
summary.docSummary: Renders step execution results with output, error messages, exit code, elapsed time, and success/failure status. Shows the next step if execution continues.

summary.summary: Renders the current workflow runtime context including all inputs and step states in a sorted, boxed format for inspection.
summary.docSummary: Displays the current workflow context with all inputs and step state information. Useful for user inspection during interactive step execution, with sorted keys for consistency.

summary.summary: Prompts the user to enter a new value for a named input, returning the edited value or the current value if input is empty.
summary.docSummary: Interactive input editor that requests the user to modify an input value. Returns the user-provided value or preserves the current value if no input is given.

summary.summary: Displays a visual warning that the workflow has been aborted by the user.
summary.docSummary: Shows a warning message indicating that the workflow was cancelled by user action.

summary.summary: Displays a message indicating a step was skipped, with optional indication of the next step.
summary.docSummary: Shows that a step was skipped during execution and displays the next step if available.

summary.summary: Displays a workflow completion message with success or status indicator depending on the final execution status.
summary.docSummary: Shows workflow completion status to the user. Displays success message if completed normally, or status message if completed with warnings or errors.

summary.summary: Displays a formatted error message with visual error indicator.
summary.docSummary: Renders an error message to the user with visual formatting.

summary.summary: Parses a string input to a workflow action enum value, validating against the hasRetry flag.
summary.docSummary: Converts user input string to a corresponding workflow action. Validates retry action availability based on the hasRetry parameter.

summary.summary: Truncates a string to a maximum length with ellipsis, replacing newlines with spaces for single-line display.
summary.docSummary: Utility function that formats a string for display by removing newlines and truncating to a specified length with ellipsis if needed.

summary.summary: Constructor that creates a new PrefixedWriter for writing output with prefixed lines
summary.docSummary: Creates a new PrefixedWriter instance configured with output destination, prefix type, step name, and colorizer for formatting CLI output

summary.summary: Implements io.Writer interface to buffer input and write lines with prefixes to output, handling incomplete lines
summary.docSummary: The Write method buffers incoming data and outputs complete lines prefixed with step/status information. It implements the standard io.Writer interface for seamless integration with io utilities.

summary.summary: Flushes remaining buffered data as a prefixed line, ensuring no incomplete lines remain in the buffer
summary.docSummary: The Flush method outputs any remaining incomplete lines from the internal buffer with appropriate prefixing. Call this after writing to ensure all data is output.

summary.summary: Helper method that constructs and writes a line with its prefix to the underlying output writer
summary.docSummary: Internal helper that combines a formatted prefix with a line and writes them to the configured output destination.

summary.summary: Builds a formatted prefix string based on prefix type, step name, and colorization settings
summary.docSummary: Constructs the prefix text that appears before each output line, including step name and status indicator (OUT/ERR), with optional color formatting.

summary.summary: Converts OutputFormat enum value to its string representation for display and serialization.
summary.docSummary: Returns the string representation of an OutputFormat value. Maps format constants to their text equivalents (text, json, table, quiet) with unknown as default. Used for CLI output format display.

summary.summary: Parses a string input to OutputFormat enum, validating against supported formats and returning error for invalid inputs.
summary.docSummary: Converts a string to an OutputFormat constant. Accepts 'text', 'json', 'table', 'quiet', or empty string (defaults to text). Returns formatted error message listing valid options on invalid input.

summary.summary: Factory constructor that creates a tableWriter instance with specified output destination and column widths.
summary.docSummary: Creates a new tableWriter for generating formatted table output. Accepts an io.Writer destination and variable column width specifications. Used internally for all table rendering operations.

summary.summary: Writes a horizontal table separator line using dashes and plus characters to mark table boundaries.
summary.docSummary: Renders a horizontal separator row for table formatting. Uses plus signs at corners and dashes for cell boundaries based on configured column widths.

summary.summary: Writes a table row with pipe-delimited cells, automatically truncating content that exceeds column width.
summary.docSummary: Renders a single table row with left-aligned cells. Truncates oversized content with ellipsis and pads cells to match column widths for aligned table output.

summary.summary: Writes a separator line that spans the entire table width based on all column specifications.
summary.docSummary: Renders a full-width separator for section breaks in table output. Calculates total width from all columns and renders a continuous separator line.

summary.summary: Writes a content row that spans the full table width with truncation for oversized content.
summary.docSummary: Renders a single row spanning all columns. Truncates content exceeding inner width and pads with spaces for alignment. Used for header and footer rows.

summary.summary: Factory constructor that creates OutputWriter with output destinations, format preference, and formatting options.
summary.docSummary: Initializes an OutputWriter for handling formatted output to stdout/stderr. Configures output format, color support via colorizer, and hint display settings. Central entry point for all output operations.

summary.summary: Checks whether the current output format is JSON, used for format-specific branching.
summary.docSummary: Returns true if output format is FormatJSON, false otherwise. Enables conditional logic for format-specific handling.

summary.summary: Returns the io.Writer destination for standard output operations.
summary.docSummary: Accessor that returns the configured output writer. Used by downstream operations to write formatted data.

summary.summary: Serializes any value to indented JSON and writes to the output destination.
summary.docSummary: Public wrapper for JSON serialization. Encodes values with 2-space indentation and writes to configured output. Handles encoding errors with formatted error messages.

summary.summary: Outputs workflow list in requested format (JSON/table/quiet/text) with format-specific formatting.
summary.docSummary: Dispatches workflow list output to appropriate format handler. Routes to JSON encoder, bordered table, quiet names-only, or text table based on configuration.

summary.summary: Outputs execution information in requested format with status, steps, and timing details.
summary.docSummary: Formats and displays execution details across multiple formats. Includes workflow name, ID, current step, duration, and per-step status and errors.

summary.summary: Outputs workflow run result in requested format with status, duration, and step outputs.
summary.docSummary: Displays execution result summary across formats. Shows workflow ID, overall status, duration, and individual step results with outputs.

summary.summary: Outputs validation result in requested format with valid status and error list.
summary.docSummary: Displays workflow validation outcome. Shows validity status and detailed error messages in format-appropriate representation.

summary.summary: Outputs validation result as table with inputs, steps, and errors or JSON format.
summary.docSummary: Renders comprehensive validation report in table or JSON format. Displays workflow structure with inputs and steps.

summary.summary: Outputs error in appropriate format with structured error detection and fallback for plain errors.
summary.docSummary: Handles error output with format-aware rendering. Detects StructuredError types for enhanced formatting; falls back to plain error text for standard errors.

summary.summary: Formats structured errors with rich text output and contextual hints in JSON or human-readable formats.
summary.docSummary: Renders structured errors with enhanced formatting. Uses HumanErrorFormatter for colorized text output with hint generators; JSON for machine parsing.

summary.summary: Factory function that creates an ErrorFormatter with color support and multiple hint generators.
summary.docSummary: Instantiates HumanErrorFormatter configured with color output and hint generators for file, YAML, state, input, command, and plugin errors.

summary.summary: Outputs prompts list in requested format (JSON/table/quiet/text) with format-specific formatting.
summary.docSummary: Dispatches prompts list to appropriate output handler. Routes through format-specific rendering: JSON, bordered table, names-only quiet, or text table.

summary.summary: Outputs workflow packs in requested format with name, version, enabled status, and workflows.
summary.docSummary: Displays installed workflow packs in format-specific representation. Includes pack metadata, enabled status, and contained workflow names.

summary.summary: Outputs plugins list in requested format with name, type, version, status, and capabilities.
summary.docSummary: Displays installed plugins across formats. Shows plugin metadata, enabled status, capabilities, and source information.

summary.summary: Outputs operations list in requested format with operation name and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Displays available operations in format-specific representation. Maps operations to their source plugins.

summary.summary: Outputs capabilities list in requested format with type, name, and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Displays system capabilities in format-specific rendering. Shows capability type, name, and providing plugin.

summary.summary: Outputs available step types in requested format with type name and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Displays supported step types. Maps step type names to their providing plugins in format-specific output.

summary.summary: Outputs validators list in requested format with validator name and description.
summary.docSummary: Displays available validators with descriptions. Supports JSON, table, quiet, and text output formats.

summary.summary: Outputs workflow dry-run plan using format-specific rendering with external formatter.
summary.docSummary: Displays dry-run execution plan. Routes to JSON encoder or external DryRunFormatter for text/table rendering.

summary.summary: Outputs resumable workflows list in requested format with ID, workflow, status, and progress.
summary.docSummary: Displays list of resumable (paused/failed) workflows. Includes workflow ID, name, current status, step, and progress.

summary.summary: Writes resumable workflows in text-based table format with tab-separated columns.
summary.docSummary: Renders resumable workflows using standard table writer with tab separation. Shows ID, workflow name, status, current step, progress, and last update time.

summary.summary: Writes resumable workflows in bordered table format with ASCII art borders.
summary.docSummary: Renders resumable workflows with custom bordered table. Uses ASCII separators and pipes for visual table structure.

summary.summary: Writes prompts in text-based table format with name, source, size, and modification time.
summary.docSummary: Renders prompts using tab-separated table format. Displays prompt metadata including size in bytes and last modified time.

summary.summary: Writes prompts in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders prompts with custom bordered table layout. Uses ASCII separators for visual table boundaries.

summary.summary: Writes plugins in text-based table format with name, type, version, status, and capabilities.
summary.docSummary: Renders plugins using tab-separated table format. Shows all plugin metadata in columns with tab separation.

summary.summary: Writes plugins in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders plugins with custom bordered table. Provides visual table structure with ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Formats workflow pack fields for table display with default values for empty fields.
summary.docSummary: Prepares workflow pack data for table rendering. Normalizes empty values to dashes and formats enabled flag as yes/no. Returns formatted fields ready for table output.

summary.summary: Writes workflow packs in text-based table format with name, version, enabled, source, and workflows.
summary.docSummary: Renders workflow packs using tab-separated table. Includes pack metadata and list of contained workflows.

summary.summary: Writes workflow packs in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders workflow packs with custom bordered table layout using ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Writes operations in text-based table format with operation name and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Renders operations using tab-separated table showing operation names and their source plugins.

summary.summary: Writes operations in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders operations with custom bordered table using ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Writes capabilities in text-based table format with type, name, and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Renders capabilities using tab-separated table showing type, name, and source plugin.

summary.summary: Writes capabilities in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders capabilities with custom bordered table using ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Writes step types in text-based table format with type name and source plugin.
summary.docSummary: Renders step types using tab-separated table showing available step types and their plugins.

summary.summary: Writes step types in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders step types with custom bordered table using ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Writes validators in text-based table format with name and description columns.
summary.docSummary: Renders validators using tab-separated table showing validator names and descriptions.

summary.summary: Writes validators in bordered table format with ASCII art structure.
summary.docSummary: Renders validators with custom bordered table using ASCII separators.

summary.summary: Internal method that encodes and writes a value as indented JSON to output stream.
summary.docSummary: Serializes a value to JSON with 2-space indentation and writes to configured output destination.

summary.summary: Internal method that encodes and writes error response as indented JSON to error output.
summary.docSummary: Serializes error response to JSON with 2-space indentation and writes to error output stream.

summary.summary: Generic JSON encoder that serializes values with 2-space indentation to specified writer.
summary.docSummary: Encodes any value as JSON with 2-space indentation. Used internally by JSON output methods. Returns wrapped encoding errors.

summary.summary: Writes workflows in text-based table format with descriptions truncated to 40 characters.
summary.docSummary: Renders workflows using tab-separated table. Shows name, source, version, and truncated descriptions.

summary.summary: Writes workflows in bordered table format with ASCII art structure and truncated descriptions.
summary.docSummary: Renders workflows with custom bordered table. Displays workflow metadata with descriptions truncated to 40 characters.

summary.summary: Formats execution info as human-readable text with workflow name, ID, status, and colored step details.
summary.docSummary: Displays execution details in plain text format with color highlighting. Shows workflow info, steps with status, and error messages.

summary.summary: Formats run result as human-readable text with colored status and duration.
summary.docSummary: Displays run result summary in plain text with color-highlighted status. Shows workflow ID, duration, and error if present.

summary.summary: Formats validation result as human-readable text with symbols and colored status.
summary.docSummary: Displays validation outcome in plain text using check/cross symbols with color. Lists validation errors with bullet points.

summary.summary: Formats execution info as bordered table with workflow header and step details.
summary.docSummary: Displays execution details in bordered table format. Shows workflow info header and step-by-step status with durations and errors.

summary.summary: Formats run result as bordered table with workflow ID, steps, outputs, and summary footer.
summary.docSummary: Displays run result in bordered table. Shows step details with outputs, calculates and displays total steps, duration, and status.

summary.summary: Formats validation result as bordered table with workflow header and error list.
summary.docSummary: Displays validation result in bordered table. Shows workflow name and validity status in header with error rows.

summary.summary: Formats input metadata fields for table display with normalized defaults and yes/no conversion.
summary.docSummary: Prepares input data for table rendering. Converts required boolean to yes/no, replaces empty defaults with dash. Returns formatted fields.

summary.summary: Formats plugin fields for table display with normalized defaults and yes/no conversion.
summary.docSummary: Prepares plugin data for table rendering. Converts enabled boolean to yes/no, joins capabilities list, normalizes empty source to dash.

summary.summary: Formats step summary fields for table display with default terminal marker for empty next field.
summary.docSummary: Prepares step data for table rendering. Replaces empty next step reference with (terminal) marker. Returns formatted step fields.

summary.summary: Renders a full-width status header row showing workflow name and validity status with smart wrapping.
summary.docSummary: Displays workflow status header spanning table width. Splits across two rows if content exceeds available width; includes workflow name and validity status.

summary.summary: Writes comprehensive validation result with tables for inputs, steps, errors, and warnings.
summary.docSummary: Renders full validation report in bordered table format. Displays inputs and steps with metadata, lists errors and warnings. Uses status header when inputs present.

summary.summary: Truncates ID string to 12 characters with ellipsis suffix for long identifiers.
summary.docSummary: Shortens long ID strings for display. Returns up to 12 characters followed by ellipsis for IDs exceeding the limit.

summary.summary: Parses RFC3339 timestamps and calculates formatted duration string with appropriate units.
summary.docSummary: Computes time difference between two RFC3339 timestamps. Returns formatted duration in milliseconds or seconds; returns dash on parse error.

summary.summary: Creates a new StdinInputReader by wrapping an io.Reader with buffering and storing an io.Writer for output prompts.
summary.docSummary: NewStdinInputReader initializes a buffered stdin reader for CLI input operations. It wraps the provided io.Reader with buffering and stores the io.Writer for displaying prompts. Use this to set up interactive stdin handling.

summary.summary: Reads a line of input from stdin with context support, printing a prompt and returning the input or an error.
summary.docSummary: ReadInput reads a single line from stdin with context-aware cancellation. It displays a '> ' prompt and reads until newline, respecting context deadlines. Use for interactive CLI prompts that need cancellation support.

summary.summary: Reads a line from a buffered reader while respecting context cancellation. Spawns a goroutine to perform the blocking read operation and returns either the trimmed line or a context-related error if cancelled.
summary.docSummary: Provides context-aware line reading from a buffered input stream. This utility reads a complete line while respecting context cancellation, allowing callers to interrupt the read operation. Returns the line with trailing carriage returns and newlines removed.

summary.summary: Creates a Cobra CLI command for validating workflow YAML files. Supports validating individual workflows, all workflows in an installed pack, or all YAML files in a directory.
summary.docSummary: Constructs the 'validate' subcommand that enables users to validate workflow definitions. Supports three modes: single workflow validation by name, pack-based validation of all workflows in an installed pack, or directory-based validation of all YAML files in a specified path.

summary.summary: Validates a single workflow definition by loading it from a repository, checking structural integrity and template interpolation references. Handles pack/workflow namespace syntax.
summary.docSummary: Executes validation of a single workflow definition. Resolves pack-namespaced workflow names, loads workflows from the appropriate repository, validates structural requirements, and analyzes template interpolation to ensure variable references are valid.

summary.summary: Batch-validates all YAML workflow files in a directory by discovering files, creating a repository, validating each workflow, and reporting results with success/failure counts.
summary.docSummary: Batch-validates all YAML workflow definitions in a specified directory. Discovers YAML files, creates a local repository, validates each workflow sequentially, and outputs formatted results showing pass/fail status and summary statistics.

summary.summary: Locates an installed workflow pack by name and validates all workflows contained within it by delegating to directory validation logic.
summary.docSummary: Validates all workflows in an installed workflow pack. Resolves the pack directory location and delegates to directory-based validation, enabling bulk validation of pack contents.

summary.summary: Scans a workflow for operation steps using disabled plugins. Analyzes step operations, extracts plugin prefixes, and collects warning messages for each disabled plugin dependency.
summary.docSummary: Analyzes a workflow to identify operations depending on disabled plugins. Initializes the plugin system in read-only mode, examines operation steps, and generates warning messages for any operations requiring unavailable plugins.

summary.summary: Creates and configures the upgrade CLI command with flags for check, force, and version options, returning a Cobra command ready for execution.
summary.docSummary: Entry point for the upgrade subcommand. Establishes CLI interface with check, force, and version flags, and wires execution to runUpgrade. Developers use this to add the upgrade command to the CLI.

summary.summary: Orchestrates the upgrade workflow by fetching GitHub releases, selecting target version, checking if update needed, and triggering download/install or check-only operations.
summary.docSummary: Primary upgrade orchestrator that coordinates GitHub API interactions, version selection, and installation flow. Handles dev builds and supports check-only mode. Core entry point for all upgrade operations.

summary.summary: Evaluates whether the current AWF version meets or exceeds the target version, factoring in force flag, dev builds, and explicit version requests.
summary.docSummary: Version comparison utility that determines upgrade necessity. Handles dev builds, forced upgrades, and version parsing errors gracefully. Supports semantic version comparison to avoid downgrading.

summary.summary: Outputs formatted message showing available update version and current version status to stdout.
summary.docSummary: Displays available update information to the user. Formats message differently for dev builds versus released versions.

summary.summary: Orchestrates complete binary upgrade including platform-specific asset selection, checksum verification, extraction, and atomic binary replacement.
summary.docSummary: Handles the full installation pipeline from release artifact selection through checksum validation to binary deployment. Ensures platform compatibility and integrity verification. Central to the physical upgrade operation.

summary.summary: Extracts the awf executable from a compressed tar archive using a temporary directory, with automatic cleanup.
summary.docSummary: Handles tarball decompression and binary extraction. Uses temp directory with automatic cleanup to isolate extraction artifacts.

summary.summary: Atomically replaces the running binary with a new version, with permission checks, symlink resolution, and package manager detection.
summary.docSummary: Performs final binary replacement with safety checks. Detects package manager installations and warns users, ensures write permissions, resolves symlinks, and reports success with version info.

summary.summary: Identifies the target release from a list by either matching a specified version or selecting the first stable release.
summary.docSummary: Release selection logic that finds releases by explicit version match or defaults to latest stable. Handles version normalization for comparison.

summary.summary: Validates directory write permission by creating a temporary test file and cleaning up.
summary.docSummary: Permission verification utility that safely tests write access to a directory. Uses temp file creation as permission probe with best-effort cleanup.

summary.summary: Constructs the root workflow CLI command and registers sub-commands for pack management.
summary.docSummary: Builds the workflow command tree entry point. Registers sub-commands for install, remove, list, info, update, and search operations.

summary.summary: Creates the 'list' subcommand for displaying all installed workflow packs.
summary.docSummary: Defines the list subcommand. Displays installed packs with version, source, and available workflows across local and global directories.

summary.summary: Discovers workflow packs from configured directories, merges by priority, and displays pack metadata.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for list command. Scans multiple directories following XDG standards, deduplicates packs by priority, and renders formatted output.

summary.summary: Creates the 'info' subcommand for displaying detailed information about a workflow pack.
summary.docSummary: Defines the info subcommand. Takes pack name and displays manifest, workflows, source, and README content.

summary.summary: Reads manifest.yaml with 1MB size limit to prevent OOM attacks from malicious packs.
summary.docSummary: Safely loads pack manifest files. Enforces size limit as security measure. Used by all pack information and installation flows.

summary.summary: Extracts description field from workflow YAML files; returns empty string on error.
summary.docSummary: Retrieves workflow metadata for display. Gracefully handles missing files and parse failures for robust rendering.

summary.summary: Returns ordered list of workflow pack directories following XDG standards with local priority.
summary.docSummary: Canonical search path enumeration. Follows XDG Base Directory spec with fallback to legacy ~/.awf location. Determines scope for discovery and installation.

summary.summary: Locates workflow pack directory across configured search paths, handling full and short names.
summary.docSummary: Pack directory resolver. Searches prioritized paths for pack by name or short name variant. Returns path or empty string.

summary.summary: Loads and displays detailed pack information including manifest, workflows, source, and README.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for info command. Gathers pack metadata from manifest and state files, renders comprehensive information output.

summary.summary: Creates the 'install' subcommand for downloading workflow packs from GitHub releases.
summary.docSummary: Defines install subcommand. Supports owner/repo[@version] format with flags for global installation and force-overwrite.

summary.summary: Parses owner/repo[@version] format into separate components for version resolution.
summary.docSummary: Argument parser for pack installation sources. Handles @version suffix for version pinning or falls back to version flag.

summary.summary: Converts owner/repo format and awf-workflow-* names into simple pack names.
summary.docSummary: Pack name normalizer. Strips path separators and prefixes to derive simple names for directories and display.

summary.summary: Returns semantic version for compatibility checks, using fallback for dev/invalid versions.
summary.docSummary: Version resolver for package compatibility. Returns '999.0.0' for development or unparseable versions to maximize compatibility.

summary.summary: Scans release assets for .tar.gz pack archive, filtering out metadata files.
summary.docSummary: Asset locator for release packages. Identifies downloadable pack archive from GitHub release assets.

summary.summary: Downloads checksums.txt from release and extracts SHA-256 checksum for pack verification.
summary.docSummary: Integrity verifier. Fetches checksums manifest and extracts hash for specific asset. Essential for tamper detection.

summary.summary: Orchestrates pack installation: resolves version, downloads archive, verifies checksum, installs atomically.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for install command. End-to-end workflow: version resolution, GitHub asset download, integrity verification, atomic installation with state tracking.

summary.summary: Reads pack manifest and emits warnings for required plugins not installed on system.
summary.docSummary: Dependency checker. Inspects pack manifest for plugin requirements and alerts user to missing dependencies.

summary.summary: Creates the 'update' subcommand for updating installed workflow packs to newer versions.
summary.docSummary: Defines update subcommand. Supports single pack update or batch update of all installed packs via --all flag.

summary.summary: Creates configured GitHub API client with endpoint and timeout settings from environment.
summary.docSummary: API client factory. Instantiates GitHub release client with configurable endpoint and HTTP timeout for API operations.

summary.summary: Scans configured directories and builds deduplication map of discovered packs with priority handling.
summary.docSummary: Full pack enumeration. Discovers all installed packs across multiple directories; higher priority dirs override lower ones.

summary.summary: Updates installed workflow packs by checking GitHub releases; supports single pack or all packs.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for update command. Updates specified pack or all installed packs; reports status and success counts.

summary.summary: Updates single pack by resolving newer GitHub releases, verifying checksums, and installing update.
summary.docSummary: Core update logic. Checks GitHub for newer versions, verifies integrity, and atomically installs update with state tracking.

summary.summary: Creates the 'remove' subcommand for uninstalling workflow packs by name.
summary.docSummary: Defines remove subcommand. Takes pack name and recursively deletes pack directory across search paths.

summary.summary: Creates the 'search' subcommand for querying available workflow packs on GitHub.
summary.docSummary: Defines search subcommand. Queries GitHub API for repositories tagged with awf-workflow topic; supports keyword filtering and JSON output.

summary.summary: Searches GitHub API for workflow packs by topic and keyword, formats output as table or JSON.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for search command. Queries GitHub API with keyword filters, respects rate limits, parses results, formats output.

summary.summary: Removes installed workflow pack by locating and recursively deleting its directory.
summary.docSummary: Execution engine for remove command. Finds pack directory and deletes all contents; reports removal path to user.

summary.summary: Thread-safe write operation delegating to internal buffer with error wrapping for StreamBuffer.
